# ===== FUNCTION: create_app() =====
# ID: F0112 · function · used
# ORIGINAL FILE: backend/scinsight/app.py:34-223
# ROLE: Application factory. Builds the database, loads the synthetic SAP data, creates the Security, Service and
#       KnowledgeBase objects, ingests the policy documents, then declares all 33 HTTP routes as nested functions
#       (closures) that share those objects. Tests call it with their own settings/database; uvicorn calls it with none.
# INPUTS:
#   settings: SciSettings | None -> configuration; None = read the environment / .env file.
#   db: Database | None          -> an existing database (tests pass an in-memory SQLite one); None = open settings.sci_database_url.
# OUTPUT:
#   FastAPI -> the ready application (routes registered, app.state holding db/service/security/kb/ingest_report).
# RAISES:
#   RuntimeError when SAP writes are enabled (forbidden in Phase 1) or when deployment API keys are missing.
# CALLED BY:
#   <- F0909 app() (calls)
#   <- F0846 test_configured_keys_rotate_out_stored_dev_keys() (calls)
#   <- F0847 test_postgres_deployment_refuses_to_start_without_all_keys() (calls)
#   <- F0851 test_sap_write_enabled_refuses_to_start() (calls)
#   <- F0852 test_expired_snapshot_blocks_calculations() (calls)
# CALLS:
#   -> F0013 SciSettings (references)
#   -> F0418 Database (references)
#   -> F0013 SciSettings (calls)
#   -> F0015 SciSettings.missing_keys() (calls)
#   -> F0417 ensure_postgres_database() (calls)
#   -> F0418 Database (calls)
#   -> F0429 Database.migrate() (calls)
#   -> F0432 load() (calls)
#   -> F0014 SciSettings.user_keys() (calls)
#   -> F0774 Security (calls)
#   -> F0311 Service (calls)
#   -> F0763 KnowledgeBase (calls)
def create_app(settings: SciSettings | None = None, db: Database | None = None) -> FastAPI:
    # SIMPLE: use the given settings, or read them from the environment.
    # TECH: `a or b` returns b when a is None; SciSettings() is a pydantic-settings model that reads env vars + .env.
    settings = settings or SciSettings()
    # BUSINESS RULE (safety): Phase 1 is read-only towards SAP. Refuse to even start if someone enabled writes.
    if settings.sap_write_enabled:
        raise RuntimeError("SAP_WRITE_ENABLED=true is not allowed in Phase 1: SupplyChain Insight AI is read-only towards SAP")
    # Deployment path (PostgreSQL). str.startswith accepts a tuple: matches either URL scheme.
    if settings.sci_database_url.startswith(("postgresql://", "postgres://")):
        # Deployments never fall back to the public sci-dev-* keys (those exist only for hermetic SQLite tests).
        # SECURITY: if fixtures (synthetic users) are loaded, every user must have a real, generated API key.
        if settings.sci_load_fixtures and settings.missing_keys():
            raise RuntimeError("missing user keys (run scripts/gen-env.py --add-missing): " + ", ".join(settings.missing_keys()))
        # Create the PostgreSQL database itself if it does not exist yet (only when we open our own connection).
        if db is None:
            ensure_postgres_database(settings.sci_database_url)
    # Open the database (SQLite file/in-memory or PostgreSQL pool) unless one was injected.
    db = db or Database(settings.sci_database_url)
    # Apply the versioned SQL migrations (backend/scinsight/migrations/*.sql) that were not applied yet.
    db.migrate()
    # Load the synthetic SAP snapshot, users and role assignments (idempotent: existing rows are kept).
    if settings.sci_load_fixtures:
        fixtures.load(db, settings.user_keys())
    # Create the shared service objects (one instance each for the whole app, captured by the route closures below).
    security = Security(db)
    service = Service(db, settings, security)
    # Knowledge base with the configured embedding model ("fastembed" bge-small, or "hash" in offline tests).
    kb = KnowledgeBase(db, make_embedder(settings.sci_embedding_backend))
    # Ingest the governed policy documents at start-up (skipped documents keep their stored chunks). {} = RAG disabled.
    ingest_report = kb.ingest_dir(settings.sci_knowledge_dir) if settings.rag_enabled else {}

    # FastAPI() creates the application. title/version/description/openapi_tags only feed the Swagger documentation.
    app = FastAPI(title="SupplyChain Insight AI — business tools", version="1.0.0", openapi_tags=TAGS,
                  description="Cosmetics supply-chain POC: synthetic SAP data, deterministic calculations, human-approved decisions, verified-outcome learning.")
    # app.state is a free-form namespace: tests read app.state.db / app.state.service directly. Tuple assignment sets 5 attributes at once.
    app.state.db, app.state.service, app.state.security, app.state.kb, app.state.ingest_report = db, service, security, kb, ingest_report

    # ===== FUNCTION: create_app.principal() =====
    # ID: F0113 · nested · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/scinsight/app.py:57-60
    # ROLE: FastAPI dependency that authenticates EVERY request: turns the API key into a Principal (user, tenant, roles).
    # INPUTS:
    #   request: Request             -> the HTTP request (required by FastAPI's signature, not read here).
    #   x_api_key: str | None        -> header "X-API-Key" (Header() converts the parameter name to the header name).
    #   authorization: str | None    -> header "Authorization: Bearer <key>" (OpenAI-style clients).
    #   x_tenant: str | None         -> header "X-Tenant"; only CHECKED against the key's tenant, never trusted.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   Principal -> frozen dataclass (user_id, tenant_id, roles, name). 401 if no/invalid key, 403 if the tenant is forged.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0114 create_app.reader() (references)
    #   <- F0114 create_app.reader() (depends_on)
    #   <- F0125 create_app.sap_write_blocked() (references)
    #   <- F0125 create_app.sap_write_blocked() (depends_on)
    #   <- F0138 create_app.review() (references)
    #   <- F0138 create_app.review() (depends_on)
    #   <- F0140 create_app.sap_execution() (references)
    #   <- F0140 create_app.sap_execution() (depends_on)
    #   <- F0141 create_app.reconcile() (references)
    #   <- F0141 create_app.reconcile() (depends_on)
    #   <- F0143 create_app.train() (references)
    #   <- F0143 create_app.train() (depends_on)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0776 Security.authenticate() (calls)
    #   -> F0772 Principal (references)
    def principal(request: Request, x_api_key: str | None = Header(default=None), authorization: str | None = Header(default=None),
                  x_tenant: str | None = Header(default=None)) -> Principal:
        # Extract the token after "Bearer " (7 characters) when an Authorization header is present; otherwise None.
        bearer = authorization[7:].strip() if authorization and authorization.lower().startswith("bearer ") else None
        # Prefer X-API-Key, fall back to the bearer token; Security.authenticate looks up the hashed key in the users table.
        return security.authenticate(x_api_key or bearer, x_tenant)

    # ===== FUNCTION: create_app.reader() =====
    # ID: F0114 · nested · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/scinsight/app.py:62-64
    # ROLE: Second-level dependency: an authenticated caller that ALSO has a read role (humans, agent_service, mlops_engineer).
    # INPUTS:
    #   p: Principal -> injected by FastAPI: Depends(principal) runs principal() first and passes its result here.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   Principal -> the same caller, after the role check (403 if none of READ_ROLES).

    # ===== FUNCTION: create_app.validate_context() =====
    # ID: F0118 · route · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/scinsight/app.py:81-87
    # ROLE: Context check that EVERY Flowise / LangGraph run performs first ("2 · Check access"): validates the caller,
    #       audits the session, and returns the identifier catalog the LLM uses to map names to codes.
    # INPUTS:
    #   body: s.ContextRequest -> JSON body {"session_id": "..."} validated by Pydantic (3-128 safe characters).
    #   p: Principal           -> injected by Depends(reader).
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> valid, session_id, tenant_id, user_id, roles, can_approve, snapshot_id, snapshot_as_of,
    #           authorized_context_ref "tenant:user:session", catalog {products, materials, locations, suppliers, production_orders}.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0656 context() (http_request)
    #   <- Decision-Outcome-Learning-Agentflow · 2 · Check access (http_request)
    #   <- Factory-Planning-Agentflow · 2 · Check access (http_request)
    #   <- Inventory-Optimizer-Agentflow · 2 · Check access (http_request)
    #   <- Logistics-Agentflow · 2 · Check access (http_request)
    #   <- Procurement-Agentflow · 2 · Check access (http_request)
    #   <- Quality-Agentflow · 2 · Check access (http_request)
    #   <- Supervisor-Agentflow · 2 · Check access (http_request)
    #   <- Warehouse-Agentflow · 2 · Check access (http_request)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0178 ContextRequest (references)
    #   -> F0772 Principal (references)
    #   -> F0114 create_app.reader() (references)
    #   -> F0313 Service.snapshot() (calls)
    #   -> F0779 Security.audit() (calls)
    #   -> F0322 Service.catalog() (calls)
    #   -> F0114 create_app.reader() (depends_on)
    #   -> F0178 ContextRequest (validates_input)
    @app.post("/api/v1/context/validate", tags=["context"])
    def validate_context(body: s.ContextRequest, p: Principal = Depends(reader)) -> dict:
        snap = service.snapshot(p.tenant_id)
        # Append an entry to the tamper-evident audit chain (who validated which session).
        security.audit(p.tenant_id, p.user_id, sorted(p.roles), "context.validated", {"session_id": body.session_id})
        # can_approve = p.is_human: an agent key can never approve (only humans with a reviewer role can).

                "can_approve": p.is_human, "snapshot_id": snap["id"], "snapshot_as_of": snap["as_of_date"],
                "authorized_context_ref": f"{p.tenant_id}:{p.user_id}:{body.session_id}", "catalog": service.catalog(p.tenant_id)}

    # ===== FUNCTION: create_app.sap_write_blocked() =====
    # ID: F0125 · route · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/scinsight/app.py:116-119
    # ROLE: Safety net: ANY write verb on /api/v1/sap/... is refused with 405 and audited (SAP is read-only in Phase 1).
    # INPUTS:
    #   path: str        -> everything after /api/v1/sap/ ("{path:path}" lets the parameter contain slashes).
    #   request: Request -> used to log the HTTP method.
    #   p: Principal     -> Depends(principal): authenticated (the attempt is attributed to a user), no role needed.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   never returns normally: always raises HTTPException(405).
    # @app.api_route registers one handler for several methods at once; include_in_schema=False hides it from Swagger.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0017 create_app() (http_request)
    #   <- F0100 create_app.sap_documents() (http_request)
    #   <- F0669 calc_factory() (http_request)
    #   <- F0670 calc_procurement() (http_request)
    #   <- F0841 test_purchase_request_carries_a_reconcilable_lead_time_prediction() (http_request)
    #   <- F0845 test_unauthenticated_and_invalid_keys() (http_request)
    #   <- F0846 test_configured_keys_rotate_out_stored_dev_keys() (http_request)
    #   <- F0848 test_forged_tenant_is_rejected_and_audited() (http_request)
    #   <- F0849 test_cross_tenant_data_is_invisible() (http_request)
    #   <- F0850 test_sap_writes_are_blocked() (http_request)
    #   <- F0853 test_missing_snapshot_blocks_calculations() (http_request)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0772 Principal (references)
    #   -> F0113 create_app.principal() (references)
    #   -> F0779 Security.audit() (calls)
    #   -> F0113 create_app.principal() (depends_on)
    @app.api_route("/api/v1/sap/{path:path}", methods=["POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE"], tags=["sap"], include_in_schema=False)
    def sap_write_blocked(path: str, request: Request, p: Principal = Depends(principal)) -> dict:
        # Audit first, so the blocked attempt is recorded even though the request fails.
        security.audit(p.tenant_id, p.user_id, sorted(p.roles), "sap.write_blocked", {"path": path, "method": request.method})
        # 405 Method Not Allowed: the API itself refuses writes; the detail tells the caller what to do instead.
        raise HTTPException(status_code=405, detail="SAP is read-only in Phase 1 (SAP_WRITE_ENABLED=false). Record approved actions instead.")

    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0840 test_outcome_learning_loop_and_model_governance() (http_request)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0772 Principal (references)
    #   -> F0113 create_app.principal() (references)

    #   -> F0534 train_lead_time_model() (calls)
    #   -> F0779 Security.audit() (calls)
    #   -> F0113 create_app.principal() (depends_on)
    @app.post("/api/v1/learning/train-lead-time-model", tags=["learning"])
    def train(p: Principal = Depends(principal)) -> dict:
        security.require(p, {"mlops_engineer"}, "Training a model")

        return result

    # ===== FUNCTION: create_app.promote() =====
    # ID: F0144 · route · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/scinsight/app.py:204-209
    # ROLE: Manual promotion gate: the supply-chain director promotes a candidate model (only if it beats the best baseline).
    # INPUTS:
    #   model_id: str -> path parameter MV-...
    #   p: Principal  -> Depends(principal) + director role check.

    #   dict -> the promoted model_versions row + {"gate": "passed: ..."} (409 if the gate fails).
    # CALLED BY:

    @app.post("/api/v1/learning/models/{model_id}/promote", tags=["learning"])
    def promote(model_id: str, p: Principal = Depends(principal)) -> dict:
        security.require(p, {"supply_chain_director"}, "Promoting a model (manual gate)")
        result = learning.promote(db, p.tenant_id, model_id, p.user_id)
        security.audit(p.tenant_id, p.user_id, sorted(p.roles), "model.promoted", {"model_version_id": model_id})
        return result

    # ===== FUNCTION: create_app.retraining() =====
    # ID: F0145 · route · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/scinsight/app.py:211-215
    # ROLE: File a retraining request (evidence = verified learning records); training itself stays a separate, manual step.
    # INPUTS:
    #   body: s.RetrainingRequest -> {"reason": 10-1000 chars}.
    #   p: Principal              -> injected by Depends(reader).
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> {"id": "RR-...", "status": "pending_human_approval", "evidence", "note"} (201 Created).
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0840 test_outcome_learning_loop_and_model_governance() (http_request)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0191 RetrainingRequest (references)
    #   -> F0772 Principal (references)
    #   -> F0114 create_app.reader() (references)
    #   -> F0537 retraining_request() (calls)
    #   -> F0779 Security.audit() (calls)
    #   -> F0114 create_app.reader() (depends_on)
    #   -> F0191 RetrainingRequest (validates_input)
    @app.post("/api/v1/learning/retraining-requests", tags=["learning"], status_code=201)
    def retraining(body: s.RetrainingRequest, p: Principal = Depends(reader)) -> dict:
        result = learning.retraining_request(db, p.tenant_id, p.user_id, body.reason)
        security.audit(p.tenant_id, p.user_id, sorted(p.roles), "model.retraining_requested", {"id": result["id"]})
        return result

    # ===== FUNCTION: create_app.audit() =====
    # ID: F0146 · route · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/scinsight/app.py:217-221
    # ROLE: Read the audit log of the tenant and verify the whole hash chain (director only).
    # INPUTS:
    #   limit: int   -> query ?limit= 1..500 (default 50); Query(ge=, le=) returns 422 outside the range.
    #   p: Principal -> Depends(principal) + director role check.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> {"chain_valid": bool, "events": [newest audit rows first]}.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0017 create_app() (http_request)
    #   <- F0101 create_app.audit() (http_request)
    #   <- F0901 Smoke.manager_decision() (http_request)
    #   <- F0848 test_forged_tenant_is_rejected_and_audited() (http_request)
    #   <- F0862 test_sap_odata_reads_and_blocks_writes() (http_request)
    #   <- F0865 test_recommendation_lifecycle_and_roles() (http_request)
    #   <- F0874 test_deep_agent_harness_settings_are_governed() (http_request)
    #   <- F0878 test_tenant_scoped_authorization() (http_request)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0772 Principal (references)
    #   -> F0113 create_app.principal() (references)
    #   -> F0777 Security.require() (calls)
    #   -> F0781 Security.verify_chain() (calls)
    #   -> F0421 Database.query() (calls)
    #   -> F0101 create_app.audit() (http_request)
    #   -> F0113 create_app.principal() (depends_on)
    @app.get("/api/v1/audit", tags=["learning"])
    def audit(limit: int = Query(default=50, ge=1, le=500), p: Principal = Depends(principal)) -> dict:
        security.require(p, {"supply_chain_director"}, "Reading the audit log")
        return {"chain_valid": security.verify_chain(),
                "events": db.query("select * from audit_events where tenant_id=? order by id desc limit ?", (p.tenant_id, limit))}

    # All routes are registered on `app`: hand the application back to uvicorn / the tests.
    return app

# ===== FUNCTION: create_app.principal() =====
    # ID: F0113 · nested · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/scinsight/app.py:57-60
    # ROLE: FastAPI dependency that authenticates EVERY request: turns the API key into a Principal (user, tenant, roles).
    # INPUTS:
    #   request: Request             -> the HTTP request (required by FastAPI's signature, not read here).
    #   x_api_key: str | None        -> header "X-API-Key" (Header() converts the parameter name to the header name).
    #   authorization: str | None    -> header "Authorization: Bearer <key>" (OpenAI-style clients).
    #   x_tenant: str | None         -> header "X-Tenant"; only CHECKED against the key's tenant, never trusted.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   Principal -> frozen dataclass (user_id, tenant_id, roles, name). 401 if no/invalid key, 403 if the tenant is forged.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0114 create_app.reader() (references)
    #   <- F0114 create_app.reader() (depends_on)
    #   <- F0125 create_app.sap_write_blocked() (references)
    #   <- F0125 create_app.sap_write_blocked() (depends_on)
    #   <- F0138 create_app.review() (references)
    #   <- F0138 create_app.review() (depends_on)
    #   <- F0140 create_app.sap_execution() (references)
    #   <- F0140 create_app.sap_execution() (depends_on)
    #   <- F0141 create_app.reconcile() (references)
    #   <- F0141 create_app.reconcile() (depends_on)
    #   <- F0143 create_app.train() (references)
    #   <- F0143 create_app.train() (depends_on)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0776 Security.authenticate() (calls)
    #   -> F0772 Principal (references)
    def principal(request: Request, x_api_key: str | None = Header(default=None), authorization: str | None = Header(default=None),
                  x_tenant: str | None = Header(default=None)) -> Principal:
        # Extract the token after "Bearer " (7 characters) when an Authorization header is present; otherwise None.
        bearer = authorization[7:].strip() if authorization and authorization.lower().startswith("bearer ") else None
        # Prefer X-API-Key, fall back to the bearer token; Security.authenticate looks up the hashed key in the users table.
        return security.authenticate(x_api_key or bearer, x_tenant)

# ===== FUNCTION: create_app.reader() =====
    # ID: F0114 · nested · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/scinsight/app.py:62-64
    # ROLE: Second-level dependency: an authenticated caller that ALSO has a read role (humans, agent_service, mlops_engineer).
    # INPUTS:
    #   p: Principal -> injected by FastAPI: Depends(principal) runs principal() first and passes its result here.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   Principal -> the same caller, after the role check (403 if none of READ_ROLES).
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0117 create_app.context() (references)
    #   <- F0117 create_app.context() (depends_on)
    #   <- F0118 create_app.validate_context() (references)
    #   <- F0118 create_app.validate_context() (depends_on)
    #   <- F0119 create_app.sap_inventory() (references)
    #   <- F0119 create_app.sap_inventory() (depends_on)
    #   <- F0120 create_app.sap_bom() (references)
    #   <- F0120 create_app.sap_bom() (depends_on)
    #   <- F0121 create_app.sap_production_orders() (references)
    #   <- F0121 create_app.sap_production_orders() (depends_on)
    #   <- F0122 create_app.sap_purchase_orders() (references)
    #   <- F0122 create_app.sap_purchase_orders() (depends_on)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0772 Principal (references)
    #   -> F0113 create_app.principal() (references)
    #   -> F0777 Security.require() (calls)
    #   -> F0113 create_app.principal() (depends_on)
    def reader(p: Principal = Depends(principal)) -> Principal:
        # Raises HTTPException(403) when the caller has none of the read roles. "This endpoint" is used in the error text.
        security.require(p, READ_ROLES, "This endpoint")
        return p

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ context
    # ===== FUNCTION: create_app.context() =====
    # ID: F0117 · route · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/scinsight/app.py:75-79
    # ROLE: "Who am I?" — identity, tenant, roles and the freshness of the tenant's SAP snapshot.
    # INPUTS:
    #   p: Principal -> injected by Depends(reader) (authenticated + read role).
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> user_id, name, tenant_id, roles (sorted list), is_human, snapshot {id, as_of, age_days, synthetic}.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   (none found)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0772 Principal (references)
    #   -> F0114 create_app.reader() (references)
    #   -> F0313 Service.snapshot() (calls)
    #   -> F0114 create_app.reader() (depends_on)
    @app.get("/api/v1/context", tags=["context"])
    def context(p: Principal = Depends(reader)) -> dict:
        # Current valid snapshot of the tenant (409 if missing or older than SCI_SNAPSHOT_MAX_AGE_DAYS).
        snap = service.snapshot(p.tenant_id)
        # sorted(p.roles): roles is a frozenset (unordered); sorting gives a stable JSON list.
        return {"user_id": p.user_id, "name": p.name, "tenant_id": p.tenant_id, "roles": sorted(p.roles), "is_human": p.is_human,
                "snapshot": {"id": snap["id"], "as_of": snap["as_of_date"], "age_days": snap["age_days"], "synthetic": bool(snap["synthetic"])}}

# ===== FUNCTION: create_app.validate_context() =====
    # ID: F0118 · route · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/scinsight/app.py:81-87
    # ROLE: Context check that EVERY Flowise / LangGraph run performs first ("2 · Check access"): validates the caller,
    #       audits the session, and returns the identifier catalog the LLM uses to map names to codes.
    # INPUTS:
    #   body: s.ContextRequest -> JSON body {"session_id": "..."} validated by Pydantic (3-128 safe characters).
    #   p: Principal           -> injected by Depends(reader).
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> valid, session_id, tenant_id, user_id, roles, can_approve, snapshot_id, snapshot_as_of,
    #           authorized_context_ref "tenant:user:session", catalog {products, materials, locations, suppliers, production_orders}.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0656 context() (http_request)
    #   <- Decision-Outcome-Learning-Agentflow · 2 · Check access (http_request)
    #   <- Factory-Planning-Agentflow · 2 · Check access (http_request)
    #   <- Inventory-Optimizer-Agentflow · 2 · Check access (http_request)
    #   <- Logistics-Agentflow · 2 · Check access (http_request)
    #   <- Procurement-Agentflow · 2 · Check access (http_request)
    #   <- Quality-Agentflow · 2 · Check access (http_request)
    #   <- Supervisor-Agentflow · 2 · Check access (http_request)
    #   <- Warehouse-Agentflow · 2 · Check access (http_request)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0178 ContextRequest (references)
    #   -> F0772 Principal (references)
    #   -> F0114 create_app.reader() (references)
    #   -> F0313 Service.snapshot() (calls)
    #   -> F0779 Security.audit() (calls)
    #   -> F0322 Service.catalog() (calls)
    #   -> F0114 create_app.reader() (depends_on)
    #   -> F0178 ContextRequest (validates_input)
    @app.post("/api/v1/context/validate", tags=["context"])
    def validate_context(body: s.ContextRequest, p: Principal = Depends(reader)) -> dict:
        snap = service.snapshot(p.tenant_id)
        # Append an entry to the tamper-evident audit chain (who validated which session).
        security.audit(p.tenant_id, p.user_id, sorted(p.roles), "context.validated", {"session_id": body.session_id})
        # can_approve = p.is_human: an agent key can never approve (only humans with a reviewer role can).
        return {"valid": True, "session_id": body.session_id, "tenant_id": p.tenant_id, "user_id": p.user_id, "roles": sorted(p.roles),
                "can_approve": p.is_human, "snapshot_id": snap["id"], "snapshot_as_of": snap["as_of_date"],
                "authorized_context_ref": f"{p.tenant_id}:{p.user_id}:{body.session_id}", "catalog": service.catalog(p.tenant_id)}

# ===== FUNCTION: create_app.sap_write_blocked() =====
    # ID: F0125 · route · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/scinsight/app.py:116-119
    # ROLE: Safety net: ANY write verb on /api/v1/sap/... is refused with 405 and audited (SAP is read-only in Phase 1).
    # INPUTS:
    #   path: str        -> everything after /api/v1/sap/ ("{path:path}" lets the parameter contain slashes).
    #   request: Request -> used to log the HTTP method.
    #   p: Principal     -> Depends(principal): authenticated (the attempt is attributed to a user), no role needed.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   never returns normally: always raises HTTPException(405).
    # @app.api_route registers one handler for several methods at once; include_in_schema=False hides it from Swagger.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0017 create_app() (http_request)
    #   <- F0100 create_app.sap_documents() (http_request)
    #   <- F0669 calc_factory() (http_request)
    #   <- F0670 calc_procurement() (http_request)
    #   <- F0841 test_purchase_request_carries_a_reconcilable_lead_time_prediction() (http_request)
    #   <- F0845 test_unauthenticated_and_invalid_keys() (http_request)
    #   <- F0846 test_configured_keys_rotate_out_stored_dev_keys() (http_request)
    #   <- F0848 test_forged_tenant_is_rejected_and_audited() (http_request)
    #   <- F0849 test_cross_tenant_data_is_invisible() (http_request)
    #   <- F0850 test_sap_writes_are_blocked() (http_request)
    #   <- F0853 test_missing_snapshot_blocks_calculations() (http_request)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0772 Principal (references)
    #   -> F0113 create_app.principal() (references)
    #   -> F0779 Security.audit() (calls)
    #   -> F0113 create_app.principal() (depends_on)
    @app.api_route("/api/v1/sap/{path:path}", methods=["POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE"], tags=["sap"], include_in_schema=False)
    def sap_write_blocked(path: str, request: Request, p: Principal = Depends(principal)) -> dict:
        # Audit first, so the blocked attempt is recorded even though the request fails.
        security.audit(p.tenant_id, p.user_id, sorted(p.roles), "sap.write_blocked", {"path": path, "method": request.method})
        # 405 Method Not Allowed: the API itself refuses writes; the detail tells the caller what to do instead.
        raise HTTPException(status_code=405, detail="SAP is read-only in Phase 1 (SAP_WRITE_ENABLED=false). Record approved actions instead.")

    def rag_search(body: s.RagSearchRequest, p: Principal = Depends(reader)) -> dict:
        # 503 Service Unavailable when the RAG feature switch is off.

# ===== FUNCTION: create_app.review() =====
    # ID: F0138 · route · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/scinsight/app.py:176-178
    # ROLE: THE human approval: an authorised human reviewer records approve / reject / modify / defer.
    # INPUTS:
    #   rec_id: str             -> path parameter REC-...
    #   body: s.ReviewRequest   -> {"decision", "explanation", optional "modifications"}.
    #   p: Principal            -> Depends(principal) only: the per-domain reviewer check happens in Service.review.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> updated recommendation + {"sap_written": False, "next_step": ...}.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0676 calc_learning() (http_request)
    #   <- F0684 verify() (http_request)
    #   <- F0685 withdraw() (http_request)
    #   <- F0520 approval_cycle() (http_request)
    #   <- F0838 test_decision_lifecycle_requires_an_authorised_human() (http_request)
    #   <- F0839 test_defer_then_review_and_withdraw() (http_request)
    #   <- F0841 test_purchase_request_carries_a_reconcilable_lead_time_prediction() (http_request)
    #   <- F0797 test_scenario_1_factory_shortage_pauses_and_proceed_is_not_an_approval() (http_request)
    #   <- F0798 test_scenario_2_transfer_is_approved_only_by_the_warehouse_manager() (http_request)
    #   <- F0799 test_scenario_3_quality_exclusions_and_reject_withdraws() (http_request)
    #   <- F0800 test_procurement_recommends_an_approved_supplier_with_demonstrated_lead_time() (http_request)
    #   <- F0810 test_supervisor_interrupt_is_not_the_approval_and_resume_reads_the_api() (http_request)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0188 ReviewRequest (references)
    #   -> F0772 Principal (references)
    #   -> F0113 create_app.principal() (references)
    #   -> F0337 Service.review() (calls)
    #   -> F0113 create_app.principal() (depends_on)
    #   -> F0188 ReviewRequest (validates_input)
    @app.post("/api/v1/decisions/{rec_id}/review", tags=["decisions"])
    def review(rec_id: str, body: s.ReviewRequest, p: Principal = Depends(principal)) -> dict:
        return service.review(p, rec_id, body.model_dump(exclude_none=True))

# ===== FUNCTION: create_app.train() =====
    # ID: F0143 · route · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/scinsight/app.py:197-202
    # ROLE: Train a candidate supplier lead-time model (MLOps engineer only) and audit it.
    # INPUTS:
    #   p: Principal -> Depends(principal) + explicit role check below.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> model_version_id, version, status "candidate", metrics, baselines, beats_best_baseline.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0840 test_outcome_learning_loop_and_model_governance() (http_request)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0772 Principal (references)
    #   -> F0113 create_app.principal() (references)
    #   -> F0777 Security.require() (calls)
    #   -> F0534 train_lead_time_model() (calls)
    #   -> F0779 Security.audit() (calls)
    #   -> F0113 create_app.principal() (depends_on)
    @app.post("/api/v1/learning/train-lead-time-model", tags=["learning"])
    def train(p: Principal = Depends(principal)) -> dict:
        security.require(p, {"mlops_engineer"}, "Training a model")
        result = learning.train_lead_time_model(db, p.tenant_id, p.user_id)
        security.audit(p.tenant_id, p.user_id, sorted(p.roles), "model.trained", {"model_version_id": result["model_version_id"]})
        return result

# ===== FUNCTION: create_app.promote() =====
    # ID: F0144 · route · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/scinsight/app.py:204-209
    # ROLE: Manual promotion gate: the supply-chain director promotes a candidate model (only if it beats the best baseline).
    # INPUTS:
    #   model_id: str -> path parameter MV-...
    #   p: Principal  -> Depends(principal) + director role check.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> the promoted model_versions row + {"gate": "passed: ..."} (409 if the gate fails).
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0840 test_outcome_learning_loop_and_model_governance() (http_request)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0772 Principal (references)
    #   -> F0113 create_app.principal() (references)
    #   -> F0777 Security.require() (calls)
    #   -> F0535 promote() (calls)
    #   -> F0779 Security.audit() (calls)
    #   -> F0113 create_app.principal() (depends_on)
    @app.post("/api/v1/learning/models/{model_id}/promote", tags=["learning"])
    def promote(model_id: str, p: Principal = Depends(principal)) -> dict:
        security.require(p, {"supply_chain_director"}, "Promoting a model (manual gate)")
        result = learning.promote(db, p.tenant_id, model_id, p.user_id)
        security.audit(p.tenant_id, p.user_id, sorted(p.roles), "model.promoted", {"model_version_id": model_id})

# ===== FUNCTION: create_app.audit() =====
    # ID: F0146 · route · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/scinsight/app.py:217-221
    # ROLE: Read the audit log of the tenant and verify the whole hash chain (director only).
    # INPUTS:
    #   limit: int   -> query ?limit= 1..500 (default 50); Query(ge=, le=) returns 422 outside the range.
    #   p: Principal -> Depends(principal) + director role check.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> {"chain_valid": bool, "events": [newest audit rows first]}.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0017 create_app() (http_request)
    #   <- F0101 create_app.audit() (http_request)
    #   <- F0901 Smoke.manager_decision() (http_request)
    #   <- F0848 test_forged_tenant_is_rejected_and_audited() (http_request)
    #   <- F0862 test_sap_odata_reads_and_blocks_writes() (http_request)
    #   <- F0865 test_recommendation_lifecycle_and_roles() (http_request)
    #   <- F0874 test_deep_agent_harness_settings_are_governed() (http_request)
    #   <- F0878 test_tenant_scoped_authorization() (http_request)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0772 Principal (references)
    #   -> F0113 create_app.principal() (references)
    #   -> F0777 Security.require() (calls)
    #   -> F0781 Security.verify_chain() (calls)
    #   -> F0421 Database.query() (calls)
    #   -> F0101 create_app.audit() (http_request)
    #   -> F0113 create_app.principal() (depends_on)
    @app.get("/api/v1/audit", tags=["learning"])
    def audit(limit: int = Query(default=50, ge=1, le=500), p: Principal = Depends(principal)) -> dict:
        security.require(p, {"supply_chain_director"}, "Reading the audit log")
        return {"chain_valid": security.verify_chain(),
                "events": db.query("select * from audit_events where tenant_id=? order by id desc limit ?", (p.tenant_id, limit))}

# ===== CLASS: EmbeddingsRequest =====
# ID: F0168 · pydantic_model · used
# ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/schemas.py:148-160
# ROLE: Body of POST /v1/embeddings (OpenAI-compatible): extra fields are IGNORED because OpenAI clients send e.g. "user".
# FIELDS:
#   input: str | list[str]; model; encoding_format "float" | "base64".
# CALLED BY:
#   <- F0078 create_app.embeddings() (references)
#   <- F0078 create_app.embeddings() (validates_input)
#   <- F0169 EmbeddingsRequest._limits() (references)
# CALLS:
#   (none found)
class EmbeddingsRequest(BaseModel):
    """OpenAI-compatible embeddings request (extra fields such as `user` are ignored, as OpenAI clients send them)."""
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="ignore")
    input: str | list[str] = Field(description="text or list of texts (max 256 items, 8000 characters each)")
    model: str | None = None
    encoding_format: Literal["float", "base64"] | None = None

    # ===== FUNCTION: EmbeddingsRequest._limits() =====
    # ID: F0169 · method · used (framework)
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/schemas.py:155-160
    # ROLE: Size limits: 1..256 texts of at most 8000 characters.
    # INPUTS:
    #   self.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   EmbeddingsRequest (ValueError -> 422).
    # CALLED BY:
    #   (none found)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0168 EmbeddingsRequest (references)
    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _limits(self) -> EmbeddingsRequest:
        items = [self.input] if isinstance(self.input, str) else self.input
        if not items or len(items) > 256 or any(len(t) > 8000 for t in items):
            raise ValueError("input must be 1-256 texts of at most 8000 characters")
        return self

# ===== CLASS: DeepAgentHarness =====
# ID: F0172 · pydantic_model · used
# ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/schemas.py:182-208
# ROLE: Harness settings of the Deep Agents supplier-research agent (body of PUT /api/v1/deep-agents/harness): model,
#       step budget, loop controls, reliability, allowed subagents and tools, output rules.
# FIELDS:
#   temperature, max_tokens, max_steps, max_model_calls, max_tool_calls, max_calls_per_tool, max_subagent_calls,
#   model_timeout_seconds, model_retries, tool_retries, subagents, tools, require_plan, require_citations, report_style.
# CALLED BY:
#   <- F0554 harness_of() (calls)
#   <- F0017 create_app() (references)
#   <- F0089 create_app.current_harness() (calls)
#   <- F0090 create_app.deep_harness() (calls)
#   <- F0091 create_app.set_deep_harness() (references)
#   <- F0091 create_app.set_deep_harness() (validates_input)
#   <- F0173 DeepAgentHarness._unique() (references)
# CALLS:
#   (none found)
class DeepAgentHarness(StrictModel):
    """Harness settings of the Deep Agents supplier-research agent (model, step budget, subagents, tools, output rules)."""
    temperature: float = Field(default=0.0, ge=0.0, le=1.0, description="Randomness of the model: 0 = same answer every time")
    max_tokens: int = Field(default=1500, ge=256, le=4000, description="Longest answer of one model call")
    max_steps: int = Field(default=60, ge=20, le=200, description="LangGraph recursion limit: total model + tool steps per run")
    # loop controls (enforced by HarnessGuard in deep_agent.py; reaching one ends the run gracefully, with the work done so far)
    max_model_calls: int = Field(default=15, ge=3, le=50, description="Thinking turns: model calls of the main agent per run")
    max_tool_calls: int = Field(default=20, ge=1, le=60, description="Data-tool and subagent calls per run, all together")
    max_calls_per_tool: int = Field(default=6, ge=1, le=20, description="Repeat guard: calls of any single data tool per run")
    max_subagent_calls: int = Field(default=4, ge=0, le=10, description="Delegations to subagents per run; 0 = no delegation at all")
    # reliability
    model_timeout_seconds: int = Field(default=120, ge=15, le=600, description="Give up on one model call after this long")
    model_retries: int = Field(default=1, ge=0, le=5, description="Retries of a failed model call")
    tool_retries: int = Field(default=1, ge=0, le=3, description="Retries of a failed tool call")
    subagents: list[Literal["contract-analyst", "quality-analyst", "logistics-analyst"]] = Field(
        default_factory=lambda: list(DEEP_SUBAGENTS), description="Specialist subagents the agent may delegate to")
    tools: list[Literal["supplier_risk", "sap_snapshot", "search_governed_knowledge", "quality_status", "logistics_status", "factory_material_readiness"]] = Field(
        default_factory=lambda: list(DEEP_TOOLS), min_length=1, description="Read-only data tools the agent may call")
    require_plan: bool = Field(default=True, description="Write a to-do plan before researching")
    require_citations: bool = Field(default=True, description="Cite the evidence id for every claim")
    report_style: Literal["full", "executive"] = Field(default="full", description="full report, or executive summary of at most 8 bullets")

    # ===== FUNCTION: DeepAgentHarness._unique() =====
    # ID: F0173 · method · used (framework)
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/schemas.py:204-208
    # ROLE: Remove duplicate subagents / tools while keeping order.
    # INPUTS:
    #   self.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   DeepAgentHarness.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   (none found)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0172 DeepAgentHarness (references)
    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _unique(self) -> DeepAgentHarness:
        self.subagents = list(dict.fromkeys(self.subagents))
        self.tools = list(dict.fromkeys(self.tools))
        return self

        # A production order carries its own SKU, quantity and date from SAP; a caller (or a model) cannot override them.
        # SECURITY: an LLM cannot send "PRD-1001 but quantity 10" to make a shortage disappear.
        if self.production_order_id and (self.sku or self.quantity or self.need_date):

# ===== FUNCTION: SupplyChainEngine._in_transit_to() =====
    # ID: F0196 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/engine.py:29-37
    # ROLE: Units of a material in transit to a warehouse that arrive by the horizon end (ETA + announced delay).
    # INPUTS:
    #   warehouse: str, material: str, horizon_end: date.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   float.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0198 SupplyChainEngine.stock_balance() (calls)
    #   <- F0205 SupplyChainEngine.inventory_overview() (calls)
    #   <- F0206 SupplyChainEngine.sales_order_fulfilment() (calls)
    #   <- F0210 SupplyChainEngine.position_health() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0406 SapRepository.has() (calls)
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    def _in_transit_to(self, warehouse: str, material: str, horizon_end: date) -> float:
        total = 0.0
        # Conditional expression inside the for: iterate shipments only if the snapshot has that section.
        for shipment in self.sap.section("shipments") if self.sap.has("shipments") else []:
            if shipment["to"] != warehouse or shipment["material"] != material or shipment["status"] not in ("in_transit", "planned"):
                continue
            eta = date.fromisoformat(shipment["eta"]) + timedelta(days=int(shipment.get("delay_days") or 0))
            if eta <= horizon_end:
                total += float(shipment["quantity"])
        return round(total, 3)

# ------------------------------------------------------- 1. factory readiness
    # ===== FUNCTION: SupplyChainEngine.factory_readiness() =====
    # ID: F0197 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/engine.py:40-122
    # ROLE: Can `plant` produce `quantity` of a finished good by `need_by`? BOM explosion with scrap, unrestricted stock, confirmed
    #       POs arriving by the need date, shortage per component, and proposed actions (expedite a later PO, or source material).
    # INPUTS:
    #   plant: str, material: str (finished good), quantity: float, need_by: date.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> use_case, status (ready | at_risk | not_ready), component_readiness_pct, components[], proposed_actions[], decision_control.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0455 LocalBackend.factory_readiness() (calls)
    #   <- F0208 SupplyChainEngine.production_overview() (calls)
    #   <- F0040 create_app.factory_readiness() (calls)
    #   <- F0106 create_app.poc_material_readiness() (calls)
    #   <- F0923 test_readiness_counts_only_unrestricted_stock_and_confirmed_pos() (calls)
    #   <- F0924 test_readiness_proposes_expedite_of_later_confirmed_po() (calls)
    #   <- F0925 test_expired_batches_are_excluded() (calls)
    #   <- F0926 test_ready_when_all_components_covered() (calls)
    #   <- F0927 test_unknown_codes_are_rejected_with_valid_values() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0409 SapRepository.validate_codes() (calls)
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    #   -> F0410 SapRepository.material() (calls)
    #   -> F0413 SapRepository.on_hand() (calls)
    #   -> F0412 SapRepository.stock_rows() (calls)
    #   -> F0404 SapRepository.as_of() (references)
    #   -> F0194 SupplyChainEngine._confirmed_pos() (calls)
    #   -> F0406 SapRepository.has() (calls)
    def factory_readiness(self, plant: str, material: str, quantity: float, need_by: date) -> dict:
        # ValueError (-> 422) for unknown codes.
        self.sap.validate_codes(plant=plant, material=material)
        bom = [row for row in self.sap.section("bom") if row["plant"] == plant and row["parent"] == material]
        if not bom:
            raise ValueError(f"No approved BOM for {material} at {plant}")
        components, proposed_actions = [], []
        for item in bom:
            component = item["component"]
            uom = self.sap.material(component)["uom"]
            # required = quantity x quantity per unit x (1 + scrap%).
            raw_required = quantity * float(item["quantity"]) * (1 + float(item["scrap_pct"]) / 100)
            # Pieces (EA) round UP; weights keep 3 decimals.
            required = math.ceil(raw_required) if uom == "EA" else round(raw_required, 3)
            on_hand = self.sap.on_hand(plant, component)
            # Itemise the stock that does NOT count (not unrestricted, or expired) for transparency.
            excluded = [
                {"batch": row["batch"], "status": row["status"] if row["status"] != "unrestricted" else "expired", "quantity": row["quantity"]}
                for row in self.sap.stock_rows(plant, component)
                if row["status"] != "unrestricted" or (row.get("expiry") and date.fromisoformat(row["expiry"]) < self.sap.as_of)
            ]
            confirmed = self._confirmed_pos(plant, component)
            # Only confirmed POs delivered on/before the need date count as inbound.
            relevant_pos = [po for po in confirmed if date.fromisoformat(po["delivery_date"]) <= need_by]
            inbound = round(sum(float(po["quantity"]) for po in relevant_pos), 3)
            available = round(on_hand + inbound, 3)
            shortage = round(max(0.0, required - available), 3)
            components.append(
                {
                    "component": component,
                    "uom": uom,
                    "required": required,
                    "unrestricted_on_hand": on_hand,
                    "confirmed_inbound_by_need_date": inbound,
                    "available": available,
                    "shortage": shortage,
                    "status": "ready" if shortage == 0 else "short",
                    "source_documents": [po["po"] for po in relevant_pos],
                    "excluded_stock": excluded,
                }
            )
            if shortage:
                # Confirmed POs arriving AFTER the need date, earliest first -> candidates to expedite.
                later = sorted(
                    (po for po in confirmed if date.fromisoformat(po["delivery_date"]) > need_by),
                    key=lambda po: po["delivery_date"],
                )
                if later:
                    proposed_actions.append(
                        {
                            "action": "expedite_purchase_order",
                            "purchase_order": later[0]["po"],
                            "supplier": later[0]["supplier"],
                            "plant": plant,
                            "material": component,
                            "quantity": min(shortage, float(later[0]["quantity"])),
                            "current_delivery_date": later[0]["delivery_date"],
                            "required_by": need_by.isoformat(),
                        }
                    )
                else:
                    # No PO to expedite: propose sourcing from the supplier that lists this component.
                    suppliers = self.sap.section("suppliers") if self.sap.has("suppliers") else []
                    supplier = next((s for s in suppliers if component in s["materials"]), None)
                    proposed_actions.append(
                        {
                            "action": "source_material",
                            "plant": plant,
                            "material": component,
                            "quantity": shortage,
                            "required_by": need_by.isoformat(),
                            "primary_supplier": supplier["name"] if supplier else None,
                            "approved_secondary_source": supplier.get("secondary_source") if supplier else None,
                        }
                    )
        # Share of components that are ready.
        readiness_pct = round(100 * sum(1 for row in components if row["status"] == "ready") / len(components), 1)
        overall = "ready" if readiness_pct == 100 else "at_risk" if readiness_pct >= 75 else "not_ready"
        return {
            "use_case": "factory_material_readiness",
            "plant": plant,
            "material": material,
            "planned_quantity": quantity,
            "need_by": need_by.isoformat(),
            "as_of": self.sap.as_of.isoformat(),
            "status": overall,
            "component_readiness_pct": readiness_pct,
            "components": components,
            "proposed_actions": proposed_actions,
            "decision_control": DECISION_CONTROL,
        }

# -------------------------------------------------------- 2. stock balancing
    # ===== FUNCTION: SupplyChainEngine.stock_balance() =====
    # ID: F0198 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/engine.py:125-167
    # ROLE: Three-warehouse balancing: stock (on hand + in transit) vs target (forecast x service factor + safety stock) per DC;
    #       the OR-Tools optimiser proposes the cheapest transfers that close the gaps.
    # INPUTS:
    #   material: str, horizon_days: int (14), service_level: float (0.95).
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> positions[], forecast_engine, forecast_training_mae, optimization, proposed_actions (= transfers), decision_control.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0456 LocalBackend.stock_balance() (calls)
    #   <- F0237 Dashboards._inventory() (calls)
    #   <- F0200 SupplyChainEngine.what_if() (calls)
    #   <- F0222 SupplyChainEngine.site_360() (calls)
    #   <- F0041 create_app.stock_balance() (calls)
    #   <- F0107 create_app.poc_warehouse_transfer() (calls)
    #   <- F0928 test_stock_balance_moves_surplus_to_gap_with_ortools() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0409 SapRepository.validate_codes() (calls)
    #   -> F0195 SupplyChainEngine._warehouses() (calls)
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    #   -> F0404 SapRepository.as_of() (references)
    #   -> F0413 SapRepository.on_hand() (calls)
    #   -> F0196 SupplyChainEngine._in_transit_to() (calls)
    #   -> F0410 SapRepository.material() (calls)
    #   -> F0531 forecast() (calls)
    #   -> F0291 optimize_transfers() (calls)
    def stock_balance(self, material: str, horizon_days: int = 14, service_level: float = 0.95) -> dict:
        self.sap.validate_codes(material=material)
        warehouses = self._warehouses()
        daily_demand = self.sap.section("warehouse_demand_daily").get(material)
        if not daily_demand:
            raise ValueError(f"No warehouse demand history for {material}")
        horizon_end = self.sap.as_of + timedelta(days=horizon_days)
        # Dict comprehensions keyed by warehouse.
        on_hand = {warehouse: self.sap.on_hand(warehouse, material) for warehouse in warehouses}
        in_transit = {warehouse: self._in_transit_to(warehouse, material, horizon_end) for warehouse in warehouses}
        stock = {warehouse: round(on_hand[warehouse] + in_transit[warehouse], 3) for warehouse in warehouses}
        safety_stock = float(self.sap.material(material).get("safety_stock", 0))
        forecast_by_warehouse = {warehouse: forecast(float(daily_demand[warehouse]), horizon_days) for warehouse in warehouses}
        # Service level scales the target (0.95 -> 1.0), clamped to 0.75..1.25.
        service_factor = max(0.75, min(1.25, service_level / 0.95))
        targets = {
            warehouse: round(forecast_by_warehouse[warehouse]["total_forecast"] * service_factor + safety_stock, 3)
            for warehouse in warehouses
        }
        # Linear program over the transport lanes (see optimizer.py).
        optimization = optimize_transfers(stock, targets, self.sap.section("lanes"))
        positions = [
            {
                "warehouse": warehouse,
                "on_hand": on_hand[warehouse],
                "in_transit_within_horizon": in_transit[warehouse],
                "forecast_demand": forecast_by_warehouse[warehouse]["total_forecast"],
                "target_stock": targets[warehouse],
                "surplus_or_gap": round(stock[warehouse] - targets[warehouse], 3),
                # max(..., 0.001) avoids division by zero.
                "days_of_cover": round(on_hand[warehouse] / max(float(daily_demand[warehouse]), 0.001), 1),
            }
            for warehouse in warehouses
        ]
        return {
            "use_case": "three_warehouse_stock_balancing",
            "material": material,
            "horizon_days": horizon_days,
            "service_level": service_level,
            "as_of": self.sap.as_of.isoformat(),
            "positions": positions,
            "forecast_engine": sorted({item["engine"] for item in forecast_by_warehouse.values()}),
            "forecast_training_mae": {w: f["training_mae"] for w, f in forecast_by_warehouse.items()},
            "optimization": optimization,
            "proposed_actions": optimization["transfers"],
            "decision_control": "Transfers are proposals only; no SAP stock-transport order is created.",
        }

# ===== FUNCTION: SupplyChainEngine.what_if() =====
    # ID: F0200 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/engine.py:180-203
    # ROLE: Hypothetical scenario: scale demand by a percentage (and flag supplier delay) and re-optimise transfers.
    # INPUTS:
    #   material: str, demand_change_pct: float, supplier_delay_days: int, horizon_days: int.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> scenario, baseline_positions, scenario_positions, optimization, proposed_actions, hypothetical=True.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0043 create_app.what_if() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0198 SupplyChainEngine.stock_balance() (calls)
    #   -> F0291 optimize_transfers() (calls)
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    def what_if(self, material: str, demand_change_pct: float, supplier_delay_days: int, horizon_days: int) -> dict:
        baseline = self.stock_balance(material, horizon_days)
        factor = 1 + demand_change_pct / 100
        scenario_positions = []
        for position in baseline["positions"]:
            demand = round(position["forecast_demand"] * factor, 3)
            # The target moves by the change in demand.
            target = round(position["target_stock"] + demand - position["forecast_demand"], 3)
            stock = position["on_hand"] + position["in_transit_within_horizon"]
            scenario_positions.append({**position, "forecast_demand": demand, "target_stock": target, "surplus_or_gap": round(stock - target, 3)})
        stock = {row["warehouse"]: row["on_hand"] + row["in_transit_within_horizon"] for row in scenario_positions}
        targets = {row["warehouse"]: row["target_stock"] for row in scenario_positions}
        optimization = optimize_transfers(stock, targets, self.sap.section("lanes"))
        if supplier_delay_days:
            for action in optimization["transfers"]:
                action["scenario_warning"] = f"Supplier receipts assumed {supplier_delay_days} days late"
        return {
            "scenario": {"demand_change_pct": demand_change_pct, "supplier_delay_days": supplier_delay_days},
            "material": material,
            "baseline_positions": baseline["positions"],
            "scenario_positions": scenario_positions,
            "optimization": optimization,
            "proposed_actions": optimization["transfers"],
            "hypothetical": True,
        }

# -------------------------------------------------------- 3. supplier risk
    # ===== FUNCTION: SupplyChainEngine.supplier_risk() =====
    # ID: F0201 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/engine.py:206-260
    # ROLE: Supplier risk scorecard from SAP receipt history: OTIF, average delay, quality rejects, open PO exposure, open quality
    #       issues, single sourcing -> score 0..100 and rating low / medium / high, with proposed actions.
    # INPUTS:
    #   supplier: str (name or code).
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> supplier master, otif_pct, average_delay_days, quality_reject_pct, single_source, open_po_exposure_eur,
    #           risk_score, risk_rating, receipts[], proposed_actions[].
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0458 LocalBackend.supplier_risk() (calls)
    #   <- F0202 SupplyChainEngine.supplier_scorecard() (calls)
    #   <- F0249 InsightEngine.evaluate() (calls)
    #   <- F0044 create_app.supplier_risk() (calls)
    #   <- F0929 test_supplier_risk_scores() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0411 SapRepository.supplier() (calls)
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    #   -> F0410 SapRepository.material() (calls)
    #   -> F0404 SapRepository.as_of() (references)
    def supplier_risk(self, supplier: str) -> dict:
        master = self.sap.supplier(supplier)
        history = [row for row in self.sap.section("po_history") if row["supplier"] == master["name"]]
        receipts = []
        for row in history:
            delay = (date.fromisoformat(row["received_date"]) - date.fromisoformat(row["promised_date"])).days
            accepted = float(row["quantity_received"]) - float(row["quality_rejected"])
            # In full = at least 98% of the ordered quantity accepted.
            in_full = accepted >= 0.98 * float(row["quantity_ordered"])
            receipts.append({**row, "delay_days": delay, "on_time": delay <= 0, "in_full": in_full, "otif": delay <= 0 and in_full})
        # `or 1` avoids dividing by zero when there is no history.
        count = len(receipts) or 1
        otif_pct = round(100 * sum(r["otif"] for r in receipts) / count, 1) if receipts else None
        avg_delay = round(sum(max(r["delay_days"], 0) for r in receipts) / count, 1) if receipts else None
        ordered = sum(float(r["quantity_ordered"]) for r in receipts) or 1
        reject_pct = round(100 * sum(float(r["quality_rejected"]) for r in receipts) / ordered, 2) if receipts else None
        open_pos = [po for po in self.sap.section("purchase_orders") if po["supplier"] == master["name"]]
        # Exposure = value of the open POs at standard cost.
        exposure = round(sum(float(po["quantity"]) * float(self.sap.material(po["material"])["unit_cost"]) for po in open_pos), 2)
        open_quality = [lot for lot in self.sap.section("quality_lots") if lot.get("supplier") == master["name"] and lot["status"] in ("inspection", "blocked")]
        single_source = not master.get("secondary_source")

        # Additive risk score (each component capped), then capped at 100.
        score = 0.0
        if otif_pct is not None:
            score += max(0.0, master["otif_target_pct"] - otif_pct) * 0.8
        score += min(25.0, (avg_delay or 0) * 2.5)
        score += min(25.0, (reject_pct or 0) * 2.5)
        score += 15.0 if single_source else 0.0
        score += 10.0 * len(open_quality)
        score = round(min(100.0, score), 1)
        rating = "high" if score >= 50 else "medium" if score >= 25 else "low"

        actions = []
        if rating != "low" and master.get("secondary_source"):
            actions.append({"action": "evaluate_secondary_source", "supplier": master["name"], "secondary_source": master["secondary_source"], "materials": master["materials"]})
        if any(lot["status"] == "blocked" for lot in open_quality):
            actions.append({"action": "issue_supplier_corrective_action_request", "supplier": master["name"], "lots": [lot["lot"] for lot in open_quality if lot["status"] == "blocked"]})
        if rating == "high" and single_source:
            actions.append({"action": "accelerate_secondary_source_qualification", "supplier": master["name"], "materials": master["materials"]})
        return {
            "use_case": "supplier_risk",
            "supplier": master,
            "as_of": self.sap.as_of.isoformat(),
            "receipts_analysed": len(receipts),
            "otif_pct": otif_pct,
            "otif_target_pct": master["otif_target_pct"],
            "average_delay_days": avg_delay,
            "quality_reject_pct": reject_pct,
            "single_source": single_source,
            "open_purchase_orders": open_pos,
            "open_po_exposure_eur": exposure,
            "open_quality_issues": open_quality,
            "risk_score": score,
            "risk_rating": rating,
            "receipts": receipts,
            "proposed_actions": actions,
            "decision_control": DECISION_CONTROL,
        }

# ===== FUNCTION: SupplyChainEngine.supplier_scorecard() =====
    # ID: F0202 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/engine.py:262-267
    # ROLE: Risk scorecard of every supplier, highest risk first.
    # INPUTS:
    #   self.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> {"use_case", "as_of", "suppliers": [summary rows]}.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0234 Dashboards._supplier_rows() (calls)
    #   <- F0212 SupplyChainEngine.product_360() (calls)
    #   <- F0213 SupplyChainEngine.product_brief() (calls)
    #   <- F0224 SupplyChainEngine.network_map() (calls)
    #   <- F0248 InsightEngine.insights() (calls)
    #   <- F0074 create_app.supplier_scorecard() (calls)
    #   <- F0261 RoleCenter._facts() (calls)
    #   <- F0929 test_supplier_risk_scores() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    #   -> F0201 SupplyChainEngine.supplier_risk() (calls)
    #   -> F0404 SapRepository.as_of() (references)
    def supplier_scorecard(self) -> dict:
        rows = []
        for supplier in self.sap.section("suppliers"):
            risk = self.supplier_risk(supplier["name"])
            # Pick some keys of the risk result and merge (|) with name + code.
            rows.append({k: risk[k] for k in ("otif_pct", "average_delay_days", "quality_reject_pct", "single_source", "open_po_exposure_eur", "risk_score", "risk_rating")} | {"supplier": supplier["name"], "code": supplier["code"]})
        return {"use_case": "supplier_scorecard", "as_of": self.sap.as_of.isoformat(), "suppliers": sorted(rows, key=lambda r: -r["risk_score"])}

# ----------------------------------------------------------- 4. quality
    # ===== FUNCTION: SupplyChainEngine.quality_status() =====
    # ID: F0203 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/engine.py:270-305
    # ROLE: Inspection lots (optionally per plant / material), unavailable quantity, the production orders they affect, and actions
    #       (expedite release of lots that block production; replace rejected material).
    # INPUTS:
    #   plant: str | None, material: str | None.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> lots, unavailable_quantity_by_material, production_impacts, proposed_actions.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0459 LocalBackend.quality_status() (calls)
    #   <- F0241 Dashboards._production() (calls)
    #   <- F0045 create_app.quality() (calls)
    #   <- F0261 RoleCenter._facts() (calls)
    #   <- F0930 test_quality_status_links_lots_to_production_orders() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0409 SapRepository.validate_codes() (calls)
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    #   -> F0404 SapRepository.as_of() (references)
    def quality_status(self, plant: str | None = None, material: str | None = None) -> dict:
        self.sap.validate_codes(plant=plant, material=material)
        lots = [
            lot
            for lot in self.sap.section("quality_lots")
            if (not plant or lot["plant"] == plant) and (not material or lot["material"] == material)
        ]
        open_lots = [lot for lot in lots if lot["status"] not in ("released",)]
        bom = self.sap.section("bom")
        impacts = []
        # Which production orders use a material that sits in an open lot?
        for lot in open_lots:
            for order in self.sap.section("production_orders"):
                components = {row["component"] for row in bom if row["plant"] == order["plant"] and row["parent"] == order["material"]}
                if order["plant"] == lot["plant"] and lot["material"] in components:
                    impacts.append({"lot": lot["lot"], "production_order": order["order"], "finished_good": order["material"], "finish_date": order["finish_date"]})
        # Two list comprehensions concatenated with "+".
        actions = [
            {"action": "expedite_quality_release", "lot": lot["lot"], "plant": lot["plant"], "material": lot["material"], "expected_release": lot["expected_release"]}
            for lot in open_lots
            if lot["status"] == "inspection" and any(i["lot"] == lot["lot"] for i in impacts)
        ] + [
            {"action": "replace_rejected_material", "lot": lot["lot"], "plant": lot["plant"], "material": lot["material"], "quantity": lot["quantity"], "supplier": lot.get("supplier")}
            for lot in open_lots
            if lot["status"] == "blocked"
        ]
        return {
            "use_case": "quality_status",
            "as_of": self.sap.as_of.isoformat(),
            "filters": {"plant": plant, "material": material},
            "lots": lots,
            "unavailable_quantity_by_material": {
                m: sum(float(lot["quantity"]) for lot in open_lots if lot["material"] == m) for m in sorted({lot["material"] for lot in open_lots})
            },
            "production_impacts": impacts,
            "proposed_actions": actions,
            "decision_control": DECISION_CONTROL,
        }

# ---------------------------------------------------------- 5. logistics
    # ===== FUNCTION: SupplyChainEngine.logistics_status() =====
    # ID: F0204 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/engine.py:308-334
    # ROLE: Shipments (optionally per warehouse / material) with revised ETA; delays above 3 days are escalated.
    # INPUTS:
    #   warehouse: str | None, material: str | None.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> shipments, delayed_count, units_delayed, lanes, proposed_actions (escalations).
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0460 LocalBackend.logistics_status() (calls)
    #   <- F0242 Dashboards._logistics() (calls)
    #   <- F0222 SupplyChainEngine.site_360() (calls)
    #   <- F0224 SupplyChainEngine.network_map() (calls)
    #   <- F0248 InsightEngine.insights() (calls)
    #   <- F0249 InsightEngine.evaluate() (calls)
    #   <- F0046 create_app.logistics() (calls)
    #   <- F0261 RoleCenter._facts() (calls)
    #   <- F0931 test_logistics_escalates_long_delays() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0409 SapRepository.validate_codes() (calls)
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    #   -> F0404 SapRepository.as_of() (references)
    def logistics_status(self, warehouse: str | None = None, material: str | None = None) -> dict:
        self.sap.validate_codes(plant=warehouse, material=material)
        shipments = [
            s
            for s in self.sap.section("shipments")
            if (not warehouse or warehouse in (s["from"], s["to"])) and (not material or s["material"] == material)
        ]
        for s in shipments:
            # Adds two computed keys to each (copied) shipment row.
            s["revised_eta"] = (date.fromisoformat(s["eta"]) + timedelta(days=int(s.get("delay_days") or 0))).isoformat()
            s["escalate"] = int(s.get("delay_days") or 0) > 3
        delayed = [s for s in shipments if s.get("delay_days")]
        actions = [
            {"action": "escalate_shipment_delay", "shipment": s["shipment"], "carrier": s["carrier"], "delay_days": s["delay_days"], "reason": s["delay_reason"]}
            for s in shipments
            if s["escalate"]
        ]
        return {
            "use_case": "logistics_status",
            "as_of": self.sap.as_of.isoformat(),
            "filters": {"warehouse": warehouse, "material": material},
            "shipments": shipments,
            "delayed_count": len(delayed),
            "units_delayed": sum(float(s["quantity"]) for s in delayed),
            "lanes": self.sap.section("lanes"),
            "proposed_actions": actions,
            "decision_control": DECISION_CONTROL,
        }

    # ID: F0205 · method · used

    # ROLE: Finished-goods positions per warehouse: on hand, demand, days of cover, open orders, in transit, below safety stock.
    # INPUTS:
    #   material: str | None.

    #   dict -> {"use_case", "as_of", "positions": [...], "proposed_actions": []}.

    #   -> F0409 SapRepository.validate_codes() (calls)
    #   -> F0195 SupplyChainEngine._warehouses() (calls)
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    #   -> F0413 SapRepository.on_hand() (calls)
    #   -> F0196 SupplyChainEngine._in_transit_to() (calls)
    #   -> F0404 SapRepository.as_of() (references)
    def inventory_overview(self, material: str | None = None) -> dict:
        self.sap.validate_codes(material=material)
        warehouses = self._warehouses()
        goods = [m for m in self.sap.section("materials") if m["type"] == "FG" and (not material or m["code"] == material)]
        demand = self.sap.section("warehouse_demand_daily")
        rows = []
        for good in goods:
            for warehouse in warehouses:
                qty = self.sap.on_hand(warehouse, good["code"])
                daily = float(demand[good["code"]][warehouse])
                open_orders = sum(float(o["quantity"]) for o in self.sap.section("sales_orders") if o["warehouse"] == warehouse and o["material"] == good["code"])
                rows.append(
                    {
                        "material": good["code"],
                        "warehouse": warehouse,
                        "on_hand": qty,
                        "daily_demand": daily,
                        "days_of_cover": round(qty / daily, 1),
                        "open_sales_orders": open_orders,
                        "in_transit_14d": self._in_transit_to(warehouse, good["code"], self.sap.as_of + timedelta(days=14)),
                        "below_safety_stock": qty < float(good["safety_stock"]),
                    }
                )
        return {"use_case": "inventory_overview", "as_of": self.sap.as_of.isoformat(), "positions": rows, "proposed_actions": []}

# --------------------------------------------------- 7. sales order fulfilment
    # ===== FUNCTION: SupplyChainEngine.sales_order_fulfilment() =====
    # ID: F0206 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/engine.py:363-420
    # ROLE: Allocate stock (+ inbound before each requested date) to open sales orders by date and priority; for shortfalls,
    #       propose the cheapest donor-DC transfer that still arrives in time, else a partial delivery.
    # INPUTS:
    #   warehouse: str | None -> filter of the result.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> orders[] (confirmed, shortfall, status, resolution), at_risk, depends_on_inbound, proposed_actions.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0462 LocalBackend.sales_orders() (calls)
    #   <- F0236 Dashboards._executive() (calls)
    #   <- F0238 Dashboards._sales() (calls)
    #   <- F0212 SupplyChainEngine.product_360() (calls)
    #   <- F0213 SupplyChainEngine.product_brief() (calls)
    #   <- F0222 SupplyChainEngine.site_360() (calls)
    #   <- F0248 InsightEngine.insights() (calls)
    #   <- F0249 InsightEngine.evaluate() (calls)
    #   <- F0047 create_app.sales_orders() (calls)
    #   <- F0261 RoleCenter._facts() (calls)
    #   <- F0935 test_sales_orders_find_shortfall_and_cheapest_on_time_transfer() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0409 SapRepository.validate_codes() (calls)
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    #   -> F0413 SapRepository.on_hand() (calls)
    #   -> F0196 SupplyChainEngine._in_transit_to() (calls)
    #   -> F0410 SapRepository.material() (calls)
    #   -> F0195 SupplyChainEngine._warehouses() (calls)
    #   -> F0404 SapRepository.as_of() (references)
    def sales_order_fulfilment(self, warehouse: str | None = None) -> dict:
        """Allocate warehouse stock (+ inbound arriving before each requested date) to open orders by date and priority;
        for shortfalls, propose the cheapest transfer from another DC whose lead time still meets the requested date."""
        self.sap.validate_codes(plant=warehouse)
        # Sort by requested date, then high priority first (False < True).
        orders = sorted(self.sap.section("sales_orders"), key=lambda o: (o["requested_date"], o["priority"] != "high"))
        lanes = {(lane["from"], lane["to"]): lane for lane in self.sap.section("lanes")}
        # Running allocations per (warehouse, material) — and per donor "transfer:<material>" reservations.
        allocated: dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}
        rows, actions = [], []
        for order in orders:
            wh, mat, due = order["warehouse"], order["material"], date.fromisoformat(order["requested_date"])
            key = (wh, mat)
            on_hand = self.sap.on_hand(wh, mat)
            supply = on_hand + self._in_transit_to(wh, mat, due)
            prior = allocated.get(key, 0.0)
            # What is left for this order after earlier orders.
            confirmed = min(float(order["quantity"]), max(0.0, supply - prior))
            allocated[key] = prior + confirmed
            shortfall = round(float(order["quantity"]) - confirmed, 3)
            inbound_needed = confirmed > max(0.0, on_hand - prior)  # cannot ship from stock alone
            status = "on_track" if not shortfall and not inbound_needed else "depends_on_inbound" if not shortfall else "at_risk"
            option = None
            if shortfall:
                safety = float(self.sap.material(mat).get("safety_stock", 0))
                donors = []
                for donor in self._warehouses():
                    lane = lanes.get((donor, wh))
                    if donor == wh or not lane:
                        continue
                    # Donor spare = on hand - its own committed orders - safety stock - already promised transfers.
                    committed = sum(float(o["quantity"]) for o in orders if o["warehouse"] == donor and o["material"] == mat)
                    spare = self.sap.on_hand(donor, mat) - committed - safety - allocated.get((donor, f"transfer:{mat}"), 0.0)
                    arrives = self.sap.as_of + timedelta(days=int(lane["lead_days"]))
                    if spare >= shortfall and arrives <= due:
                        donors.append((float(lane["cost_per_unit"]), donor, lane, arrives))
                if donors:
                    # min() on tuples -> cheapest cost per unit first.
                    _, donor, lane, arrives = min(donors)
                    allocated[(donor, f"transfer:{mat}")] = allocated.get((donor, f"transfer:{mat}"), 0.0) + shortfall
                    option = {
                        "action": "stock_transfer", "from": donor, "to": wh, "material": mat, "quantity": shortfall,
                        "lead_days": lane["lead_days"], "arrives": arrives.isoformat(), "estimated_cost": round(shortfall * float(lane["cost_per_unit"]), 2),
                        "carbon_kg": round(shortfall * float(lane["carbon_kg_per_unit"]), 2), "for_sales_order": order["order"],
                    }
                else:
                    option = {"action": "propose_partial_delivery", "sales_order": order["order"], "warehouse": wh, "material": mat,
                              "deliverable_now": confirmed, "shortfall": shortfall, "customer": order["customer"]}
                actions.append(option)
            rows.append({**order, "available_by_due_date": round(supply, 3), "confirmed": round(confirmed, 3), "shortfall": shortfall,
                         "status": status, "resolution": option})
        # The allocation always runs network-wide (fair order priority); the filter applies to the output only.
        if warehouse:
            rows = [r for r in rows if r["warehouse"] == warehouse]
            actions = [a for a in actions if a.get("to", a.get("warehouse")) == warehouse]
        return {
            "use_case": "sales_order_fulfilment",
            "as_of": self.sap.as_of.isoformat(),
            "orders": rows,
            "at_risk": sum(r["status"] == "at_risk" for r in rows),
            "depends_on_inbound": sum(r["status"] == "depends_on_inbound" for r in rows),
            "proposed_actions": actions,
            "decision_control": DECISION_CONTROL,
        }
