# ===== FUNCTION: SupplyChainEngine.kpis() =====
    # ID: F0226 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/engine.py:1223-1248
    # ROLE: Network KPIs: inventory value, at-risk positions (< 7 days of cover), open POs / production orders, open quality lots,
    #       delayed shipments, supplier count.
    # INPUTS:
    #   self.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0075 create_app.kpis() (calls)
    #   <- F0932 test_inventory_and_kpis() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0195 SupplyChainEngine._warehouses() (calls)
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    #   -> F0413 SapRepository.on_hand() (calls)
    #   -> F0404 SapRepository.as_of() (references)
    def kpis(self) -> dict:
        warehouses = self._warehouses()
        finished_goods = [row for row in self.sap.section("materials") if row["type"] == "FG"]
        inventory_value = 0.0
        risks = []
        for material in finished_goods:
            for warehouse in warehouses:
                qty = self.sap.on_hand(warehouse, material["code"])
                inventory_value += qty * float(material["unit_cost"])
                demand = self.sap.section("warehouse_demand_daily")[material["code"]][warehouse]
                cover = qty / demand
                if cover < 7:
                    risks.append({"severity": "high" if cover < 4 else "medium", "warehouse": warehouse, "material": material["code"], "days_of_cover": round(cover, 1)})
        lots = self.sap.section("quality_lots")
        return {
            "as_of": self.sap.as_of.isoformat(),
            "inventory_value": round(inventory_value, 2),
            "at_risk_positions": risks,
            "at_risk_count": len(risks),
            "open_purchase_orders": len(self.sap.section("purchase_orders")),
            "open_production_orders": len(self.sap.section("production_orders")),
            "quality_lots_open": sum(1 for lot in lots if lot["status"] in ("inspection", "blocked")),
            "shipments_delayed": sum(1 for s in self.sap.section("shipments") if s.get("delay_days")),
            "suppliers": len(self.sap.section("suppliers")),
            "currency": "EUR",
        }

def _status_cover(pct: float | None) -> str:

# ===== FUNCTION: Dashboards.product_scope() =====
    # ID: F0231 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/dashboards.py:42-49
    # ROLE: The product scope: a finished good plus its BOM components (None = the whole network).
    # INPUTS:
    #   material: str | None.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   set[str] | None (ValueError when the material is not a finished good).
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0232 Dashboards.build() (calls)
    #   <- F0261 RoleCenter._facts() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0410 SapRepository.material() (calls)
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    def product_scope(self, material: str | None) -> set[str] | None:
        """A finished good plus its BOM components; None means the whole network."""
        if not material:
            return None
        master = self.engine.sap.material(material)
        if master["type"] != "FG":
            raise ValueError(f"{material} is not a finished good")
        # Set union of {material} and the set comprehension of its components.
        return {material} | {b["component"] for b in self.engine.sap.section("bom") if b["parent"] == material}

# ===== FUNCTION: Dashboards.build() =====
    # ID: F0232 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/dashboards.py:51-59
    # ROLE: Build one persona dashboard by dispatching to _<persona>(scope, material).
    # INPUTS:
    #   persona: str (key of PERSONAS), material: str | None.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> persona, title, task, as_of, product focus, kpis, charts, tables (+ forecast / analysis).
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0065 create_app.dashboard() (calls)
    #   <- F0280 RoleCenter._charts() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0231 Dashboards.product_scope() (calls)
    #   -> F0410 SapRepository.material() (calls)
    def build(self, persona: str, material: str | None = None) -> dict:
        if persona not in PERSONAS:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown dashboard {persona}. Options: {', '.join(PERSONAS)}")
        scope = self.product_scope(material)
        body = getattr(self, f"_{persona}")(scope, material)
        focus = None
        if material:
            focus = {"material": material, "description": self.engine.sap.material(material)["description"], "scope": sorted(scope)}
        return {"persona": persona, **PERSONAS[persona], "as_of": self.engine.sap.as_of.isoformat(), "product": focus, **body}

    # ===== FUNCTION: Dashboards._understock_chart() =====
    # ID: F0233 · method · used (framework)
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/dashboards.py:62-68
    # ROLE: Chart of the 10 most understocked positions (lowest coverage %, then largest shortfall value).
    # INPUTS:
    #   rows: list[dict] (position_health rows), title: str.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> bar chart spec.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0236 Dashboards._executive() (calls)
    #   <- F0237 Dashboards._inventory() (calls)
    #   <- F0241 Dashboards._production() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0227 _status_cover() (calls)
    def _understock_chart(self, rows: list[dict], title: str) -> dict:
        top = sorted((r for r in rows if r["shortfall"] > 0), key=lambda r: (r["coverage_pct"] or 0, -r["shortfall_value_eur"]))[:10]
        return {"id": "understock", "type": "bar", "title": title, "subtitle": "available (stock + confirmed inbound, 14 days) as % of target; target = need + safety stock",
                "unit": "%", "reference": 100, "reference_label": "target",
                "rows": [{"label": f"{r['material']} @ {r['location']}", "value": r["coverage_pct"], "status": _status_cover(r["coverage_pct"]),
                          "hint": f"{r['description']}: {r['on_hand']:,.0f} on hand + {r['inbound']:,.0f} inbound vs target {r['target']:,.0f} {r['uom']} · short {r['shortfall']:,.0f} (€{r['shortfall_value_eur']:,.0f})"}
                         for r in top]}

# ===== FUNCTION: Dashboards._supplier_rows() =====
    # ID: F0234 · method · used (framework)
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/dashboards.py:70-79
    # ROLE: Supplier scorecard rows (within scope) enriched with contract / effective lead time, OTIF target and materials.
    # INPUTS:
    #   scope.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   list[dict].
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0240 Dashboards._procurement() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0202 SupplyChainEngine.supplier_scorecard() (calls)
    #   -> F0411 SapRepository.supplier() (calls)
    def _supplier_rows(self, scope) -> list[dict]:
        rows = []
        for s in self.engine.supplier_scorecard()["suppliers"]:
            master = self.engine.sap.supplier(s["supplier"])
            if scope is not None and not scope & set(master["materials"]):
                continue
            rows.append({**s, "contract_lead_time_days": master["contract_lead_time_days"],
                         "effective_lead_time_days": round(master["contract_lead_time_days"] + (s["average_delay_days"] or 0), 1),
                         "otif_target_pct": master["otif_target_pct"], "materials": ", ".join(master["materials"])})
        return rows

# ===== FUNCTION: Dashboards._mentions() =====
    # ID: F0235 · method · used (framework)
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/dashboards.py:81-86
    # ROLE: Does an insight mention a material of the scope (code or description) anywhere in its text, evidence or action?
    # INPUTS:
    #   insight: dict, scope.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   bool.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0236 Dashboards._executive() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0410 SapRepository.material() (calls)
    def _mentions(self, insight: dict, scope) -> bool:
        if scope is None:
            return True
        text = insight["title"] + insight["detail"] + json.dumps(insight["evidence"]) + json.dumps(insight["action"])
        names = {self.engine.sap.material(code)["description"] for code in scope}
        return any(token in text for token in scope | names)

    # ===== FUNCTION: Dashboards._executive() =====
    # ID: F0236 · method · used (framework)
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/dashboards.py:89-120
    # ROLE: Executive dashboard: critical insights, fill rate, value short, expiring stock, decisions waiting / executed; insights by
    #       area, recommendation pipeline, understocked positions; top priorities table.
    # INPUTS:
    #   scope, material.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   (none found)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0248 InsightEngine.insights() (calls)
    #   -> F0235 Dashboards._mentions() (calls)
    #   -> F0210 SupplyChainEngine.position_health() (calls)
    #   -> F0228 _in() (calls)
    #   -> F0206 SupplyChainEngine.sales_order_fulfilment() (calls)
    #   -> F0389 Store.counts() (calls)
    #   -> F0225 SupplyChainEngine.expiry_risk() (calls)
    #   -> F0233 Dashboards._understock_chart() (calls)
    def _executive(self, scope, material) -> dict:
        insights = [i for i in self.insights.insights() if self._mentions(i, scope)]
        positions = [r for r in self.engine.position_health() if _in(scope, r["material"])]
        orders = [o for o in self.engine.sales_order_fulfilment()["orders"] if _in(scope, o["material"])]
        counts = self.store.counts(self.engine.sap.snapshot["id"])["recommendations"]  # this customer only
        qty = sum(float(o["quantity"]) for o in orders)
        fill = 100 * sum(float(o["confirmed"]) for o in orders) / qty if qty else 100
        value_at_risk = sum(r["shortfall_value_eur"] for r in positions)
        expiring = sum(r["value_eur"] for r in self.engine.expiry_risk(90) if _in(scope, r["material"]))
        cats = Counter((i["category"], i["severity"]) for i in insights)
        categories = sorted({c for c, _ in cats})
        return {
            "kpis": [
                {"label": "Critical insights", "value": sum(i["severity"] == "critical" for i in insights), "status": "critical", "hint": "needs action today"},
                {"label": "Order fill rate", "value": round(fill, 1), "unit": "%", "status": "good" if fill >= 98 else "warning", "hint": "confirmed / ordered, open orders"},
                {"label": "Value short vs target", "value": round(value_at_risk), "unit": "€", "status": "warning", "hint": "positions in scope, at cost"},
                {"label": "Stock expiring ≤ 90 days", "value": round(expiring), "unit": "€", "status": "warning" if expiring else "good"},
                {"label": "Awaiting your decision", "value": counts.get("pending_review", 0), "status": "info", "hint": "this customer"},
                {"label": "Executed in SAP sandbox", "value": counts.get("executed", 0), "status": "good", "hint": "this customer"},
            ],
            "charts": [
                {"id": "insights", "type": "stacked", "title": "Open insights by area", "subtitle": "deterministic, from the SAP snapshot",
                 "series": ["critical", "warning", "info"], "status_series": True,
                 "rows": [{"label": c, "segments": [{"name": s, "value": cats.get((c, s), 0)} for s in ("critical", "warning", "info")]} for c in categories]},
                {"id": "decisions", "type": "bar", "title": "Recommendation pipeline", "subtitle": "agent / planner proposals → manager decision → SAP sandbox",
                 "unit": "", "rows": [{"label": s.replace("_", " "), "value": counts.get(s, 0), "status": {"rejected": "critical", "executed": "good"}.get(s, "info")}
                                      for s in ("pending_review", "accepted", "executed", "rejected")]},
                self._understock_chart(positions, "Top 10 understocked positions"),
            ],
            "tables": [{"title": "Top priorities", "columns": ["Severity", "Area", "Insight"],
                        "rows": [[i["severity"], i["category"], i["title"]] for i in insights[:8]]}],
        }

# ===== FUNCTION: Dashboards._inventory() =====
    # ID: F0237 · method · used (framework)
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/dashboards.py:122-155
    # ROLE: Inventory dashboard: positions below target, stock-out risk, inventory / excess / expiring value; understock, days of cover,
    #       surplus-gap (stock balance of the focus product) and shelf-life charts; forecast chart reference.
    # INPUTS:
    #   scope, material.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   (none found)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0210 SupplyChainEngine.position_health() (calls)
    #   -> F0228 _in() (calls)
    #   -> F0225 SupplyChainEngine.expiry_risk() (calls)
    #   -> F0198 SupplyChainEngine.stock_balance() (calls)
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    #   -> F0233 Dashboards._understock_chart() (calls)
    #   -> F0410 SapRepository.material() (calls)
    def _inventory(self, scope, material) -> dict:
        positions = [r for r in self.engine.position_health() if _in(scope, r["material"])]
        fg = [r for r in positions if r["material_type"] == "FG"]
        expiry = [r for r in self.engine.expiry_risk(180) if _in(scope, r["material"])]
        # Default focus: the finished good with the lowest days of cover anywhere (works for every customer's catalogue)
        focus = material or min(fg, key=lambda r: r["days_of_cover"] if r["days_of_cover"] is not None else 1e9)["material"]
        balance = self.engine.stock_balance(focus)
        demand = self.engine.sap.section("warehouse_demand_daily")[focus]
        return {
            "kpis": [
                {"label": "Positions below target", "value": sum(r["shortfall"] > 0 for r in positions), "status": "warning", "hint": f"of {len(positions)} material × location"},
                {"label": "Stock-out risk (< 7 days)", "value": sum((r["days_of_cover"] or 99) < 7 for r in fg), "status": "critical"},
                {"label": "Inventory value", "value": round(sum(r["stock_value_eur"] for r in positions)), "unit": "€", "status": "info"},
                {"label": "Excess stock (> 2× target)", "value": round(sum(r["excess_value_eur"] for r in positions)), "unit": "€", "status": "warning", "hint": "cash tied up"},
                {"label": "Expiring ≤ 180 days", "value": round(sum(r["value_eur"] for r in expiry)), "unit": "€", "status": "warning"},
            ],
            "charts": [
                self._understock_chart(positions, "Top 10 understocked products" if scope is None else "Understocked positions (product + components)"),
                {"id": "cover", "type": "bar", "title": "Days of cover — finished goods by DC", "subtitle": "on hand ÷ daily demand; alert below 7 days",
                 "unit": " d", "reference": 7, "reference_label": "7-day alert",
                 "rows": [{"label": f"{r['material']} @ {r['location']}", "value": r["days_of_cover"],
                           "status": "critical" if r["days_of_cover"] < 4 else "warning" if r["days_of_cover"] < 7 else "good",
                           "hint": f"{r['on_hand']:,.0f} units, {r['requirement'] / 14:,.0f}/day"} for r in sorted(fg, key=lambda r: r["days_of_cover"])]},
                {"id": "gap", "type": "diverging", "title": f"{self.engine.sap.material(focus)['description']}: surplus (+) / gap (−) vs target by DC",
                 "subtitle": "XGBoost 14-day forecast + safety stock; OR-Tools moves surplus to gaps",
                 "unit": " units", "rows": [{"label": p["warehouse"], "value": p["surplus_or_gap"]} for p in balance["positions"]]},
                {"id": "expiry", "type": "bar", "title": "Shelf-life risk: batches expiring within 180 days", "subtitle": "days left; value at cost in the hint",
                 "unit": " d", "rows": [{"label": f"{r['batch']} · {r['material']} @ {r['plant']}", "value": r["days_left"],
                                         "status": "critical" if r["state"] != "warning" else "warning",
                                         "hint": f"{r['quantity']:,.0f} units, €{r['value_eur']:,.0f}, expires {r['expiry']}"} for r in expiry]},
            ],
            # The UI loads the forecast-vs-actuals chart of the focus product at its highest-demand DC.
            "forecast": {"material": focus, "warehouse": max(demand, key=lambda wh: float(demand[wh]))},
            "tables": [],
        }

# ===== FUNCTION: _id() =====
# ID: F0243 · function · used
# ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/insights.py:15-16
# ROLE: Stable insight id from its parts ("IN-" + 10 hex chars): the same situation always gets the same id.
# INPUTS:
#   *parts -> any values.
# OUTPUT:
#   str.
# CALLED BY:
#   <- F0248 InsightEngine.insights() (calls)
# CALLS:
#   (none found)
def _id(*parts) -> str:
    # map(str, parts) converts each part to text before joining.
    return "IN-" + hashlib.sha1("|".join(map(str, parts)).encode()).hexdigest()[:10]

# ===== FUNCTION: InsightEngine.insights() =====
    # ID: F0248 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/insights.py:30-130
    # ROLE: All insights: stock-out / overstock positions, sales orders at risk, production readiness, high-risk suppliers, escalated
    #       shipments, stocktake differences — each with severity, category, title, detail, metric, evidence, UI action and a
    #       suggested copilot question; sorted by severity then category.
    # INPUTS:
    #   self.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   list[dict].
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0236 Dashboards._executive() (calls)
    #   <- F0066 create_app.get_insights() (calls)
    #   <- F0934 test_insights_are_plain_english_deterministic_and_sorted() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0205 SupplyChainEngine.inventory_overview() (calls)
    #   -> F0405 SapRepository.snapshot() (references)
    #   -> F0243 _id() (calls)
    #   -> F0246 InsightEngine._plant() (calls)
    #   -> F0247 InsightEngine._mat() (calls)
    #   -> F0206 SupplyChainEngine.sales_order_fulfilment() (calls)
    #   -> F0208 SupplyChainEngine.production_overview() (calls)
    #   -> F0202 SupplyChainEngine.supplier_scorecard() (calls)
    #   -> F0204 SupplyChainEngine.logistics_status() (calls)
    #   -> F0207 SupplyChainEngine.stocktake_reconciliation() (calls)
    def insights(self) -> list[dict]:
        out: list[dict] = []
        # Bound method alias: add(x) == out.append(x).
        add = out.append

        # Stock-out and overstock risk by warehouse position
        for p in self.engine.inventory_overview()["positions"]:
            cover, wh, mat = p["days_of_cover"], p["warehouse"], p["material"]
            evidence = [{"label": "On hand", "value": p["on_hand"]}, {"label": "Daily demand", "value": p["daily_demand"]},
                        {"label": "Open sales orders", "value": p["open_sales_orders"]}, {"label": "In transit (14 d)", "value": p["in_transit_14d"]},
                        {"label": "Source", "value": f"SAP snapshot {self.sap.snapshot['id']} · A_MaterialStock, A_SalesOrderItem, A_Shipment"}]
            # Rule: < 7 days of cover = risk (critical < 4); > 30 days = likely donor.
            if cover < 7:
                add({"id": _id("stockout", wh, mat), "severity": "critical" if cover < 4 else "warning", "category": "Inventory",
                     # ":g" formats a number without trailing zeros.
                     "title": f"{self._plant(wh)} has about {cover:g} days of {self._mat(mat)} left",
                     "detail": f"{p['on_hand']:,.0f} units on hand against {p['daily_demand']:,.0f}/day demand and {p['open_sales_orders']:,.0f} units "
                               f"on open sales orders; {p['in_transit_14d']:,.0f} units are in transit.",
                     "metric": {"label": "days of cover", "value": cover}, "evidence": evidence,
                     "action": {"label": "Rebalance stock", "kind": "stock_balance", "params": {"material": mat, "warehouse": wh}},
                     "ask": f"How should we rebalance {mat} to protect {wh}?"})
            elif cover > 30:
                add({"id": _id("overstock", wh, mat), "severity": "info", "category": "Inventory",
                     "title": f"{self._plant(wh)} holds {cover:g} days of {self._mat(mat)} — a likely transfer donor",
                     "detail": f"{p['on_hand']:,.0f} units on hand for {p['daily_demand']:,.0f}/day demand.",
                     "metric": {"label": "days of cover", "value": cover}, "evidence": evidence,
                     "action": {"label": "Rebalance stock", "kind": "stock_balance", "params": {"material": mat, "warehouse": wh}},
                     "ask": f"Can {wh} supply other DCs with {mat}?"})

        # Sales orders
        for o in self.engine.sales_order_fulfilment()["orders"]:
            if o["status"] == "on_track":
                continue
            fix = o["resolution"] or {}
            fix_text = (f" Fix: transfer {fix['quantity']:,.0f} from {fix['from']} (arrives {fix['arrives']}, €{fix['estimated_cost']:,.0f})."
                        if fix.get("action") == "stock_transfer" else " No DC can cover it in time — propose a partial delivery." if fix else "")
            add({"id": _id("so", o["order"]), "severity": "critical" if o["status"] == "at_risk" else "warning", "category": "Sales orders",
                 "title": (f"Order {o['order']} for {o['customer']} is short by {o['shortfall']:,.0f} units" if o["status"] == "at_risk"
                           else f"Order {o['order']} for {o['customer']} depends on stock still in transit"),
                 "detail": f"{o['quantity']:,.0f} × {self._mat(o['material'])} from {o['warehouse']} due {o['requested_date']} ({o['priority']} priority); "
                           f"{o['available_by_due_date']:,.0f} available by then.{fix_text}",
                 "metric": {"label": "shortfall", "value": o["shortfall"]},
                 "evidence": [{"label": "Sales order", "value": o["order"]}, {"label": "Requested", "value": o["requested_date"]},
                              {"label": "Confirmed", "value": o["confirmed"]}, {"label": "Source", "value": "A_SalesOrderItem, A_MaterialStock, A_Shipment, A_TransportLane"}],
                 "action": {"label": "Plan fulfilment", "kind": "sales_orders", "params": {}},
                 "ask": f"How do we fulfil sales order {o['order']} on time?"})

        # Production readiness
        for o in self.engine.production_overview()["orders"]:
            if o["readiness"] == "ready":
                continue
            add({"id": _id("prod", o["order"]), "severity": "critical" if o["readiness"] == "not_ready" else "warning", "category": "Production",
                 "title": f"Production order {o['order']} ({self._mat(o['material'])}, {self._plant(o['plant'])}) is {o['readiness'].replace('_', ' ')}",
                 "detail": f"{o['quantity']:,.0f} units due {o['finish_date']}; short: {', '.join(o['short_components'])}. "
                           f"{o['component_readiness_pct']}% of components are covered.",
                 "metric": {"label": "components covered", "value": f"{o['component_readiness_pct']}%"},
                 "evidence": [{"label": "Order", "value": o["order"]}, {"label": "Short components", "value": ", ".join(o["short_components"])},
                              {"label": "Rule", "value": "SOP SC-104: unrestricted stock + confirmed POs by need date"}],
                 "action": {"label": "Check readiness", "kind": "factory_readiness",
                            "params": {"plant": o["plant"], "material": o["material"], "quantity": o["quantity"], "need_by": o["finish_date"]}},
                 "ask": f"Can {o['plant']} produce {o['quantity']:g} {o['material']} by {o['finish_date']}?"})

        # Suppliers
        for s in self.engine.supplier_scorecard()["suppliers"]:
            if s["risk_rating"] != "high":
                continue
            add({"id": _id("supplier", s["supplier"]), "severity": "warning", "category": "Suppliers",
                 "title": f"{s['supplier']} is a high continuity risk",
                 "detail": f"OTIF {s['otif_pct']}%, average delay {s['average_delay_days']} days, rejects {s['quality_reject_pct']}%"
                           f"{', single source' if s['single_source'] else ''}; €{s['open_po_exposure_eur']:,.0f} open PO exposure.",
                 "metric": {"label": "risk score", "value": s["risk_score"]},
                 "evidence": [{"label": "OTIF", "value": f"{s['otif_pct']}%"}, {"label": "Reject rate", "value": f"{s['quality_reject_pct']}%"},
                              {"label": "Source", "value": "A_PurchaseOrderHistory, A_InspectionLot, supplier contracts"}],
                 "action": {"label": "Research supplier", "kind": "supplier", "params": {"supplier": s["supplier"]}},
                 "ask": f"Is {s['supplier']} a continuity risk? Cite the contract."})

        # Logistics
        for s in self.engine.logistics_status()["shipments"]:
            if s.get("escalate"):
                add({"id": _id("ship", s["shipment"]), "severity": "warning", "category": "Logistics",
                     "title": f"Shipment {s['shipment']} to {s['to']} is {s['delay_days']} days late",
                     "detail": f"{s['quantity']:,.0f} × {self._mat(s['material'])} via {s['carrier']} ({s['mode']}); revised ETA {s['revised_eta']}. "
                               f"Reason: {s['delay_reason']}.",
                     "metric": {"label": "days late", "value": s["delay_days"]},
                     "evidence": [{"label": "Carrier SLA policy", "value": "LP-05: delays above SLA trigger a claim review"}],
                     "action": {"label": "View shipments", "kind": "suppliers", "params": {}},
                     "ask": f"What is the impact of the delay on shipment {s['shipment']}?"})

        # Stocktake
        for c in self.engine.stocktake_reconciliation()["counts"]:
            if c["status"] in ("matched",):
                continue
            sev = "warning" if c["status"] == "investigate" else "info"
            # ":+g" shows the sign (+ or -).
            why = "; ".join(f"{e['type'].replace('_', ' ')} {e['document']} ({e['quantity']:+g})" for e in c["evidence"]) or "no movement explains it"
            add({"id": _id("count", c["count_id"]), "severity": sev, "category": "Stocktake",
                 "title": f"Count difference of {c['difference']:+g} for {c['material']} at {c['plant']} — {c['status'].replace('_', ' ')}",
                 "detail": f"Book {c['book_quantity']:,.0f}, counted {c['counted_quantity']:,.0f} (€{c['difference_value_eur']:,.0f}). Explanation: {why}.",
                 "metric": {"label": "unexplained", "value": c["unexplained"]},
                 "evidence": [{"label": "Count", "value": c["count_id"]}] + [{"label": e["type"], "value": f"{e['document']} {e['quantity']:+g}"} for e in c["evidence"]],
                 "action": {"label": "Reconcile", "kind": "stocktake", "params": {}},
                 "ask": f"Why is there a stock count difference for {c['material']} at {c['plant']}?"})

        out.sort(key=lambda i: (SEVERITY_ORDER[i["severity"]], i["category"]))
        return out

    # ===== FUNCTION: MoatEngine.consent() =====
    # ID: F0252 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/moat.py:48-54
    # ROLE: Consent of a tenant to industry learning: a recorded decision wins; otherwise synthetic demo customers are opted in and the
    #       primary customer is opted out.
    # INPUTS:
    #   tenant_id: str.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> {"tenant", "industry_learning": bool, "source"}.
    # CALLED BY:

    #   <- F0255 MoatEngine.view() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0384 Store.consent() (calls)
    def consent(self, tenant_id: str) -> dict:
        """Recorded consent wins; without a record, synthetic demo customers are opted in and real ones are opted out."""
        row = self.store.consent(tenant_id)
        if row:
            return {"tenant": tenant_id, "industry_learning": row["industry_learning"], "source": f"recorded by {row['updated_by']} {row['updated_at'][:10]}"}
        synthetic = tenant_id != DEFAULT_TENANT  # the generated demo customers; the primary customer starts opted out
        return {"tenant": tenant_id, "industry_learning": bool(synthetic), "source": "default: synthetic demo customer (simulated consent)" if synthetic else "default: not shared"}

# -------------------------------------------------------------- model comparison
    # ===== FUNCTION: MoatEngine.model_comparison() =====
    # ID: F0254 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/moat.py:61-89
    # ROLE: Demand-weighted WAPE of customer-only XGBoost vs naive baseline vs generic (all consenting customers) vs industry (same
    #       industry, + own history if this customer consents) vs cold start.
    # INPUTS:
    #   tenant_id: str.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> customer_only_wape, baseline_wape, generic_wape, industry_wape, cold_start_wape, participants, notes.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0255 MoatEngine.view() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0393 TenantRegistry.get() (calls)
    #   -> F0253 MoatEngine._series() (calls)
    #   -> F0529 evaluate_models() (calls)
    #   -> F0252 MoatEngine.consent() (calls)
    #   -> F0530 pooled_evaluation() (calls)
    def model_comparison(self, tenant_id: str) -> dict:
        ctx = self.registry.get(tenant_id)
        target = self._series(tenant_id)
        evals = [evaluate_models(b) for b in target]
        weight = sum(target) or 1
        # Weighted average of per-series WAPE by demand volume.
        customer_only = sum(e["model"]["wape_pct"] * b for e, b in zip(evals, target, strict=True)) / weight
        baseline = sum(e["baseline"]["wape_pct"] * b for e, b in zip(evals, target, strict=True)) / weight
        others = [t for t in self.registry.files if t != tenant_id]
        # CONSENT GATE: only customers that agreed can contribute their data.
        consenting = [t for t in others if self.consent(t)["industry_learning"]]
        same_industry = [t for t in consenting if self.registry.get(t).industry == ctx.industry]
        own_consent = self.consent(tenant_id)["industry_learning"]
        donors = lambda ids: tuple(sorted(b for t in ids for b in self._series(t)))  # noqa: E731
        generic = pooled_evaluation(target, donors(consenting), False) if consenting else None
        industry = pooled_evaluation(target, donors(same_industry), own_consent) if same_industry else None
        cold = pooled_evaluation(target, donors(same_industry), False, scale_by_history=False) if same_industry else None
        wape = lambda r: None if r is None else r["wape_pct"]  # noqa: E731
        return {
            "customer_only_wape": round(customer_only, 2), "baseline_wape": round(baseline, 2),
            "generic_wape": wape(generic), "industry_wape": wape(industry), "cold_start_wape": wape(cold),
            "participants": {"industry": ctx.industry, "same_industry_consenting": same_industry, "all_consenting": len(consenting),
                             "this_customer_contributes": own_consent},
            "notes": [
                "Customer-only = XGBoost per series on this customer's history; baseline = same weekday last week.",
                "Generic = one model trained on every consenting customer of every industry (not this customer), scaled to this customer's demand level.",
                f"Industry = consenting {ctx.industry_label} customers" + (" plus this customer's history" if own_consent else " (this customer does not contribute)") + ".",
                "Cold start = industry model with none of this customer's history, scaled by its planned daily demand (a newly onboarded customer).",
                "Caution: the demo histories are synthetic and share one seasonal shape, which flatters pooled models; real customers differ, so validate on real holdouts before promoting an industry model.",
            ],
        }

# -------------------------------------------------------------- the view
    # ===== FUNCTION: MoatEngine.view() =====
    # ID: F0255 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/moat.py:92-179
    # ROLE: The full moat page: value proposition, evidence per moat, flywheel stage counts, the five moat metrics, model comparison,
    #       consent of this and peer customers, verified value by benefit line, ownership, decisions and outcomes.
    # INPUTS:
    #   tenant_id: str.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0057 create_app.moat_view() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0393 TenantRegistry.get() (calls)
    #   -> F0405 SapRepository.snapshot() (references)
    #   -> F0290 RoleCenter.learning() (calls)
    #   -> F0388 Store.decision_stats() (calls)
    #   -> F0380 Store.list_outcomes() (calls)
    #   -> F0367 Store.list_recommendations() (calls)
    #   -> F0254 MoatEngine.model_comparison() (calls)
    #   -> F0252 MoatEngine.consent() (calls)
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    #   -> F0406 SapRepository.has() (calls)
    #   -> F0224 SupplyChainEngine.network_map() (calls)
    #   -> F0253 MoatEngine._series() (calls)
    def view(self, tenant_id: str) -> dict:
        ctx = self.registry.get(tenant_id)
        sap, engine, roles = ctx.sap, ctx.engine, ctx.roles
        snapshot = sap.snapshot["id"]
        learning = roles.learning()
        s = learning["summary"]
        decisions = self.store.decision_stats(snapshot)
        outcomes = self.store.list_outcomes(snapshot)
        recs = self.store.list_recommendations(snapshot_id=snapshot)
        kinds = {r["id"]: r["kind"] for r in recs}
        models = self.model_comparison(tenant_id)
        consent = self.consent(tenant_id)

        # 1. evidence per data moat
        records = sum(len(sap.section(k)) for k in ("sales_orders", "purchase_orders", "po_history", "stock", "production_orders", "shipments", "quality_lots", "stocktake_counts", "goods_movements") if sap.has(k))
        net = engine.network_map()
        gaps = sorted(net["suppliers"], key=lambda x: -(x["learned_vs_sap_days"] or 0))
        reality = [f"{x['name']}: SAP promises {x['sap_lead_time_days']} d, actually {x['learned_time_to_deliver_days']:g} d" for x in gaps if (x["learned_vs_sap_days"] or 0) > 0][:3]
        lanes = sap.section("lanes")
        evidence = {
            "erp_history": {"value": f"{records} SAP records · {len(self._series(tenant_id))} demand series × 180 days",
                            "learned": f"forecast WAPE {models['customer_only_wape']}% vs {models['baseline_wape']}% for the simple baseline"},
            "supplier_reality": {"value": f"{len(sap.section('po_history'))} receipts from {len(net['suppliers'])} suppliers",
                                 "learned": "; ".join(reality) or "suppliers deliver on promise"},
            "human_expertise": {"value": f"{decisions['decided']} decisions · {decisions['modified']} modified · {decisions['rejected']} rejected",
                                "learned": (", ".join(f"{k.replace('_', ' ')} ×{v}" for k, v in decisions["reason_codes"].items()) or "no override reasons recorded yet")},
            "verified_outcomes": {"value": f"{s['observed']} of {s['executed']} executed decisions observed in SAP",
                                  "learned": f"{s['achieved_pct']}% achieved · €{s['realized_impact_eur']:,.0f} realised" if s["observed"] else "awaiting the first observed outcome"},
            "operating_knowledge": {"value": f"{len(sap.section('bom'))} BOM rules · {len(lanes)} transfer lanes · {len(sap.section('plants'))} sites with contacts",
                                    "learned": "constraints used by every optimisation (lanes, BOM, safety stock, quality status)"},
            "industry_learning": {"value": f"{len(models['participants']['same_industry_consenting'])} other consenting {ctx.industry_label} customer(s)",
                                  "learned": ("industry model WAPE " + (f"{models['industry_wape']}%" if models["industry_wape"] is not None else "n/a") +
                                              f" vs customer-only {models['customer_only_wape']}%")},
        }
        moats = [{"id": mid, "name": name, "learns": learns, "potential": potential, **evidence[mid]} for mid, name, learns, potential in MOAT_POTENTIAL]

        # 2. flywheel stages with live counts
        labels = [o for o in outcomes if o["status"] != "awaiting_observation"]
        flywheel = [
            {"stage": "Private customer data", "detail": "SAP · suppliers · inventory · demand · production", "count": records, "unit": "records"},
            {"stage": "AI prediction & optimisation", "detail": "forecast shortages, compare suppliers, recommend replenishment",
             "count": self.store.counts(snapshot)["analyses"], "unit": "analyses"},
            {"stage": "Real human decisions", "detail": "approve · modify · reject · explain why", "count": decisions["decided"], "unit": "decisions"},
            {"stage": "Verified business outcomes", "detail": "actual delivery · costs · delays · stock-outs · quality", "count": len(labels), "unit": "outcomes"},
            {"stage": "Supervised learning + MLOps", "detail": "validated labels → better datasets → evaluated models", "count": len(labels), "unit": "validated labels",
             "extra": f"{len(learning['models'])} models evaluated on holdout"},
        ]

        # 3. value realised so far, by benefit line (verified outcomes only)
        realised: dict[str, float] = {}
        for o in outcomes:
            if o["achieved"] and o["realized_impact_eur"]:
                line = VALUE_LINES.get(kinds.get(o["recommendation_id"], ""), "Faster planning")
                realised[line] = realised.get(line, 0) + o["realized_impact_eur"]

        # 4. the five moat-strength metrics
        uplift = None if models["baseline_wape"] == 0 else round(100 * (1 - models["customer_only_wape"] / models["baseline_wape"]), 1)
        personal = None if models["generic_wape"] is None else round(models["generic_wape"] - models["customer_only_wape"], 2)
        industry_adv = None if models["industry_wape"] is None else round(models["customer_only_wape"] - models["industry_wape"], 2)
        metrics = [
            {"name": "Verified decision outcomes", "value": s["observed"], "unit": "", "display": f"{s['observed']} of {s['executed']}",
             "question": "How many AI recommendations have complete, reliable real-world result records?"},
            {"name": "Model accuracy uplift", "value": uplift, "unit": "%", "display": f"{uplift}% lower error than baseline" if uplift is not None else "—",
             "question": "How much does the trained model outperform the existing baseline?"},
            {"name": "Business value realised", "value": s["realized_impact_eur"], "unit": "€", "display": f"€{s['realized_impact_eur']:,.0f} verified",
             "question": "How much verified cost reduction or service improvement did the AI help achieve?"},
            {"name": "Customer personalisation advantage", "value": personal, "unit": " pts",
             "display": f"{personal:+} WAPE pts vs generic model" if personal is not None else "no consenting data for a generic model",
             "question": "How much better is the customer-specific model than a generic model? (+ = customer model better)"},
            {"name": "Industry learning advantage", "value": industry_adv, "unit": " pts",
             "display": (f"{industry_adv:+} WAPE pts vs customer-only; cold start {models['cold_start_wape']}%" if industry_adv is not None else "needs other consenting customers in this industry"),
             "question": "Does authorised industry data improve predictions, particularly for newly onboarded customers? (+ = industry model better)"},
        ]
        return {
            "as_of": sap.as_of.isoformat(), "tenant": tenant_id, "customer": ctx.customer, "industry": ctx.industry, "industry_label": ctx.industry_label,
            "value_proposition": {
                "title": "Turning real supply-chain experience into competitive intelligence",
                "text": ("Every customer builds its own private intelligence moat from proprietary business data, human expertise and verified "
                         "operational outcomes. With controlled, permission-based industry learning, the platform turns these experiences into "
                         "increasingly effective prediction and optimisation models across verticals."),
                "moat": "The moat is not the SAP data itself: it is the continuously validated ability to turn real business experience into better decisions.",
            },
            "moats": moats, "flywheel": flywheel, "metrics": metrics, "models": models, "consent": consent,
            "industry_customers": [{"tenant": t, "customer": self.registry.labels[t][2], **self.consent(t)} for t in self.registry.files
                                   if self.registry.labels[t][0] == ctx.industry],
            "realised_by_line": realised, "ownership": OWNERSHIP,
            "decisions": decisions, "outcomes": outcomes[:20], "data_moat": learning["data_moat"],
        }

# ===== FUNCTION: _status() =====
# ID: F0257 · function · used
# ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/roles.py:151-156
# ROLE: Traffic-light status of a KPI vs its target: "up" KPIs good at/above target (warning within 10%), "down" KPIs good at/below
#       target (warning within +25%).
# INPUTS:
#   value, target: numbers or None; direction: "up" | "down".
# OUTPUT:
#   str -> "good" | "warning" | "critical" | "info" (no value or no target).
# CALLED BY:
#   <- F0258 kpi() (calls)
#   <- F0282 RoleCenter._demand() (calls)
#   <- F0289 RoleCenter._mlops() (calls)
# CALLS:
#   (none found)
def _status(value, target, direction) -> str:
    if value is None or target is None:
        return "info"
    if direction == "up":
        return "good" if value >= target else "warning" if value >= target * 0.9 else "critical"
    return "good" if value <= target else "warning" if value <= target * 1.25 else "critical"

#   label, value, unit, target, direction, definition, formula, source; hint, status (override), available (default True).
# OUTPUT:
#   dict -> label, value (1 decimal), unit, target, direction, status, definition, formula, source, hint, available.
# CALLED BY:
#   <- F0267 RoleCenter.platform_kpis() (calls)
#   <- F0270 RoleCenter.industry_kpis() (calls)
#   <- F0281 RoleCenter._director() (calls)

#   <- F0288 RoleCenter._finance() (calls)
#   <- F0289 RoleCenter._mlops() (calls)
# CALLS:
#   -> F0257 _status() (calls)
def kpi(label, value, unit, target, direction, definition, formula, source, hint=None, status=None, available=True) -> dict:
    """A KPI with its agreed definition. available=False means the SAP source is not in this snapshot yet."""
    if not available:
        value, status = None, "info"
    return {"label": label, "value": None if value is None else round(value, 1), "unit": unit, "target": target, "direction": direction,
            "status": status or _status(value, target, direction), "definition": definition, "formula": formula, "source": source,
            "hint": hint if available else f"needs SAP data: {source}", "available": available}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ shared facts (computed once per request)
    # ===== FUNCTION: RoleCenter._facts() =====
    # ID: F0261 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/roles.py:173-199
    # ROLE: Compute every shared fact once per request (optionally scoped to one product): product briefs + issues, sales orders,
    #       position health, unit costs, forecast model evaluations, suppliers, production, quality, expiry, counts, logistics,
    #       calendar, outcomes, decision stats, executed recommendations.
    # INPUTS:
    #   material: str | None.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict (the "f" passed to every builder below).
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0269 RoleCenter.north_star() (calls)
    #   <- F0272 RoleCenter.build() (calls)
    #   <- F0290 RoleCenter.learning() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0231 Dashboards.product_scope() (calls)
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    #   -> F0213 SupplyChainEngine.product_brief() (calls)
    #   -> F0206 SupplyChainEngine.sales_order_fulfilment() (calls)
    #   -> F0210 SupplyChainEngine.position_health() (calls)
    #   -> F0529 evaluate_models() (calls)
    #   -> F0202 SupplyChainEngine.supplier_scorecard() (calls)
    #   -> F0411 SapRepository.supplier() (calls)
    #   -> F0208 SupplyChainEngine.production_overview() (calls)
    #   -> F0203 SupplyChainEngine.quality_status() (calls)
    #   -> F0225 SupplyChainEngine.expiry_risk() (calls)
    #   -> F0207 SupplyChainEngine.stocktake_reconciliation() (calls)
    def _facts(self, material: str | None) -> dict:
        e = self.engine
        sap = e.sap
        # Set of materials in scope (the product and its components), or empty = everything.
        scope = self.dashboards.product_scope(material)
        fgs = [m["code"] for m in sap.section("materials") if m["type"] == "FG" and (not material or m["code"] == material)]
        briefs = [e.product_brief(code) for code in fgs]
        orders = [o for o in e.sales_order_fulfilment()["orders"] if not scope or o["material"] in scope]
        positions = [r for r in e.position_health() if not scope or r["material"] in scope]
        cost = {m["code"]: float(m["unit_cost"]) for m in sap.section("materials")}
        demand = sap.section("warehouse_demand_daily")
        models = []
        for code in fgs:
            for wh, daily in demand.get(code, {}).items():
                if float(daily):
                    # One model evaluation per demand series (cached in forecasting.evaluate_models).
                    models.append({"material": code, "warehouse": wh, "daily": float(daily), **evaluate_models(float(daily))})
        return {
            "scope": scope, "fgs": fgs, "briefs": briefs, "orders": orders, "positions": positions, "cost": cost, "models": models,
            # Flatten the issues of all product briefs, tagging each with its product (dict | dict merge).
            "issues": [i | {"product": b["description"], "material": b["material"]} for b in briefs for i in b["issues"]],
            "suppliers": [s for s in e.supplier_scorecard()["suppliers"]
                          if not scope or scope & set(sap.supplier(s["supplier"])["materials"])],
            "production": [o for o in e.production_overview()["orders"] if not scope or o["material"] in scope],
            "quality": e.quality_status(), "expiry": [r for r in e.expiry_risk(180) if not scope or r["material"] in scope],
            "counts": [c for c in e.stocktake_reconciliation()["counts"] if not scope or c["material"] in scope],
            "logistics": e.logistics_status(), "calendar": e.sales_outlook(material)["calendar"],
            "outcomes": self.store.list_outcomes(sap.snapshot["id"]), "decisions": self.store.decision_stats(sap.snapshot["id"]),
            "executed": self.store.list_recommendations("executed", sap.snapshot["id"]),
        }

# ===== FUNCTION: RoleCenter._supply_chain_cost() =====
    # ID: F0266 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/roles.py:217-230
    # ROLE: 30-day supply-chain cost estimate: procurement (open POs) + transport (proposed transfers) + storage (carrying cost) +
    #       expiry (stock expiring <= 30 days) + exceptions (air freight in flight).
    # INPUTS:
    #   f.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> {"total", "parts": {...}}.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0267 RoleCenter.platform_kpis() (calls)
    #   <- F0269 RoleCenter.north_star() (calls)
    #   <- F0288 RoleCenter._finance() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    #   -> F0263 RoleCenter._inventory_value() (calls)
    def _supply_chain_cost(self, f) -> dict:
        """30-day estimate: procurement (open POs) + transport (proposed transfers) + storage (carrying) + expiry + exceptions."""
        sap = self.engine.sap
        price = {(s["name"], m): s.get("unit_price_eur") for s in sap.section("suppliers") for m in s["materials"]}
        procurement = sum(float(po["quantity"]) * (price.get((po["supplier"], po["material"])) or f["cost"][po["material"]])
                          for po in sap.section("purchase_orders") if not f["scope"] or po["material"] in f["scope"])
        transport = sum(i["fix_cost_eur"] or 0 for i in f["issues"] if i["area"] in ("Stock", "Sales orders") and i["severity"] != "info")
        storage = self._inventory_value(f) * CARRYING_COST_RATE * 30 / 365
        expiry = sum(r["value_eur"] for r in f["expiry"] if r["days_left"] <= 30)
        lanes = {(lane["from"], lane["to"]): lane for lane in f["logistics"]["lanes"]}
        exceptions = sum(float(s["quantity"]) * lanes.get((s["from"], s["to"]), {}).get("cost_per_unit", 0)
                         for s in f["logistics"]["shipments"] if s["mode"] == "air" and s["status"] in ("in_transit", "planned"))
        parts = {"procurement": procurement, "transport": transport, "storage": storage, "expiry": expiry, "exceptions": exceptions}
        return {"total": round(sum(parts.values()), 0), "parts": {k: round(v, 0) for k, v in parts.items()}}

# ===== FUNCTION: RoleCenter.platform_kpis() =====
    # ID: F0267 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/roles.py:232-253
    # ROLE: The five platform KPIs: projected OTIF, material readiness, inventory turnover, forecast WAPE, 30-day supply-chain cost.
    # INPUTS:
    #   f.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   list[dict] (kpi()).
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0269 RoleCenter.north_star() (calls)
    #   <- F0281 RoleCenter._director() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0263 RoleCenter._inventory_value() (calls)
    #   -> F0264 RoleCenter._annual_cogs() (calls)
    #   -> F0266 RoleCenter._supply_chain_cost() (calls)
    #   -> F0258 kpi() (calls)
    #   -> F0262 RoleCenter._otif() (calls)
    #   -> F0265 RoleCenter._wape() (calls)
    def platform_kpis(self, f) -> list[dict]:
        orders = f["production"]
        ready = 100 * sum(o["readiness"] == "ready" for o in orders) / len(orders) if orders else None
        value = self._inventory_value(f)
        turns = self._annual_cogs(f) / value if value else None
        sc = self._supply_chain_cost(f)
        return [
            kpi("Customer OTIF (projected)", self._otif(f), "%", 95, "up", "Orders delivered on time and in full ÷ eligible orders",
                "open orders projected on time and in full ÷ open orders × 100", "SD sales orders + stock + inbound",
                hint=f"{len(f['orders'])} open orders; delivered-order history is needed for actual OTIF"),
            kpi("Material readiness", ready, "%", 95, "up", "Production orders with all usable materials ready ÷ scheduled orders",
                "ready production orders ÷ scheduled production orders × 100", "PP production orders + BOM + stock + POs", hint=f"{len(orders)} scheduled orders"),
            kpi("Inventory turnover", turns, "×", 8, "up", "Cost of goods sold ÷ average inventory value",
                "annualised forecast demand × standard cost ÷ stock value at cost", "MM stock + material standard cost + demand",
                hint=f"stock €{value:,.0f} at cost"),
            kpi("Forecast WAPE", self._wape(f), "%", 20, "down", "Sum of absolute forecast errors ÷ sum of actual demand",
                "Σ|forecast − actual| ÷ Σ actual × 100 on a 14-day holdout, demand-weighted", "SD billing history (synthetic in this POC)",
                hint="lower is better · synthetic history"),
            kpi("Supply-chain cost (30 d)", sc["total"], "€", None, "down", "Agreed procurement, transport, storage, expiry and exception costs",
                "open PO value + proposed transfer cost + carrying cost (25%/yr) + expiring stock ≤30 d + air freight in flight", "MM/PUR/LE + assumptions",
                hint=" · ".join(f"{k} €{v:,.0f}" for k, v in sc["parts"].items()), status="info"),
        ]

# ===== FUNCTION: RoleCenter.learning_summary() =====
    # ID: F0268 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/roles.py:255-272
    # ROLE: Learning summary: error reduction vs baseline, max drift, executed / observed / verified outcomes, achieved %, realised
    #       impact (verified only), overdue observations, acceptance / override stats.
    # INPUTS:
    #   f.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0269 RoleCenter.north_star() (calls)
    #   <- F0281 RoleCenter._director() (calls)
    #   <- F0288 RoleCenter._finance() (calls)
    #   <- F0289 RoleCenter._mlops() (calls)
    #   <- F0290 RoleCenter.learning() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   (none found)
    def learning_summary(self, f) -> dict:
        outcomes = f["outcomes"]
        observed = [o for o in outcomes if o["status"] != "awaiting_observation"]
        executed = max(len(f["executed"]), len(outcomes))  # decisions executed before outcome tracking still count as awaiting
        verified = [o for o in observed if o["achieved"]]
        models = f["models"]
        weight = sum(m["daily"] for m in models) or 1
        reduction = sum((m["error_reduction_pct"] or 0) * m["daily"] for m in models) / weight if models else None
        drift = max((m["drift"]["change_pts"] for m in models), default=None)
        # ISO date strings compare correctly as text ("2026-10-20" < "2026-10-21").
        overdue = [o for o in outcomes if o["status"] == "awaiting_observation" and o["due_date"] and o["due_date"] < self.engine.sap.as_of.isoformat()]
        return {
            "error_reduction_pct": None if reduction is None else round(reduction, 1),
            "drift_max_pts": drift, "executed": executed, "observed": len(observed), "verified": len(verified),
            "verified_pct": round(100 * len(observed) / executed, 1) if executed else None,
            "achieved_pct": round(100 * len(verified) / len(observed), 1) if observed else None,
            "realized_impact_eur": round(sum(o["realized_impact_eur"] or 0 for o in verified), 0), "overdue": len(overdue),
            **{k: f["decisions"][k] for k in ("acceptance_pct", "override_pct", "decided", "override_reasons")},
        }

# ===== FUNCTION: RoleCenter.north_star() =====
    # ID: F0269 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/roles.py:274-294
    # ROLE: GET /api/v1/northstar: the north-star statement with its three components (fulfilment, cost, inventory risk), the learning
    #       components, platform KPIs and industry KPIs.
    # INPUTS:
    #   material: str | None.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0055 create_app.north_star() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0261 RoleCenter._facts() (calls)
    #   -> F0268 RoleCenter.learning_summary() (calls)
    #   -> F0262 RoleCenter._otif() (calls)
    #   -> F0266 RoleCenter._supply_chain_cost() (calls)
    #   -> F0267 RoleCenter.platform_kpis() (calls)
    #   -> F0270 RoleCenter.industry_kpis() (calls)
    def north_star(self, material: str | None = None) -> dict:
        f = self._facts(material)
        # Inventory risk = shortfall value + stock expiring <= 90 days + excess stock value.
        risk = (sum(r["shortfall_value_eur"] for r in f["positions"]) + sum(r["value_eur"] for r in f["expiry"] if r["days_left"] <= 90)
                + sum(r["excess_value_eur"] for r in f["positions"]))
        learning = self.learning_summary(f)
        return {
            **NORTH_STAR, "as_of": self.engine.sap.as_of.isoformat(),
            "components": [

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ industry KPIs
    # ===== FUNCTION: RoleCenter.industry_kpis() =====
    # ID: F0270 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/roles.py:297-339
    # ROLE: The four KPIs of the tenant's industry, picked from a catalogue of 19 computed (or unavailable) KPIs.
    # INPUTS:
    #   f.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> {"industry", "rules", "kpis": [...]}.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0269 RoleCenter.north_star() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    #   -> F0263 RoleCenter._inventory_value() (calls)
    #   -> F0404 SapRepository.as_of() (references)
    #   -> F0411 SapRepository.supplier() (calls)
    #   -> F0258 kpi() (calls)
    def industry_kpis(self, f) -> dict:
        sap = self.engine.sap
        materials = {m["code"]: m for m in sap.section("materials")}
        comp_pos = [r for r in f["positions"] if r["material_type"] != "FG"]
        # Packaging = codes starting with "PK" or packaging material types; the rest of the components are raw materials.
        pack = [r for r in comp_pos if r["material"].startswith("PK") or materials[r["material"]]["type"] in ("PACK", "PK", "packaging")]
        rm = [r for r in comp_pos if r not in pack]
        # Share of positions covered at >= 100% of target.
        covered = lambda rows: 100 * sum((r["coverage_pct"] or 0) >= 100 for r in rows) / len(rows) if rows else None  # noqa: E731
        value = self._inventory_value(f) or 1
        expired = sum(r["value_eur"] for r in f["expiry"] if r["days_left"] < 0)
        stock = [s for s in sap.section("stock") if not f["scope"] or s["material"] in f["scope"]]
        lots = f["quality"]["lots"]
        waiting = [(date.fromisoformat(lot["expected_release"]) - sap.as_of).days for lot in lots if lot["status"] == "inspection" and lot.get("expected_release")]
        approved = [s for s in f["suppliers"] if sap.supplier(s["supplier"]).get("approved", True)]
        fg_expiry = [(date.fromisoformat(s["expiry"]) - sap.as_of).days for s in stock if s.get("expiry") and materials[s["material"]]["type"] == "FG"]
        rm_expiry = [(date.fromisoformat(s["expiry"]) - sap.as_of).days for s in stock if s.get("expiry") and materials[s["material"]]["type"] != "FG"]
        fg_pos = [r for r in f["positions"] if r["material_type"] == "FG"]
        qty = sum(float(o["quantity"]) for o in f["orders"])
        fill = 100 * sum(float(o["confirmed"]) for o in f["orders"]) / qty if qty else None
        not_ready = [o for o in f["production"] if o["readiness"] != "ready"]
        otd = [s["otif_pct"] for s in f["suppliers"] if s["otif_pct"] is not None]
        catalogue = {
            "Packaging readiness": kpi("Packaging readiness", covered(pack), "%", 95, "up", "Packaging positions covered for the next 14 days", "packaging positions at ≥100% of target ÷ packaging positions", "MM stock + POs", available=bool(pack)),
            "Promotion forecast accuracy": kpi("Promotion forecast accuracy", None, "%", None, "up", "Forecast accuracy during promotions", "1 − WAPE on promotion periods", "promotion calendar (SD/CRM)", available=False),
            "Batch expiry loss": kpi("Batch expiry loss", 100 * expired / value, "%", 0.5, "down", "Value of expired stock ÷ inventory value", "expired batch value ÷ stock value × 100", "MM batch expiry dates"),
            "Ingredient availability": kpi("Ingredient availability", covered(rm), "%", 95, "up", "Raw-material positions covered for the next 14 days", "RM positions at ≥100% of target ÷ RM positions", "MM stock + POs", available=bool(rm)),
            "Quality release lead time": kpi("Quality release lead time", sum(waiting) / len(waiting) if waiting else 0, " d", 3, "down", "Average days until lots in inspection are released", "Σ(expected release − today) ÷ lots in inspection", "QM inspection lots"),
            "Lot traceability": kpi("Lot traceability", 100 * sum(bool(s.get("batch")) for s in stock) / len(stock) if stock else None, "%", 100, "up", "Stock quantities carrying a batch number", "stock records with batch ÷ stock records", "MM batch management"),
            "Qualified supplier reliability": kpi("Qualified supplier reliability", sum(s["otif_pct"] or 0 for s in approved) / len(approved) if approved else None, "%", 95, "up", "OTIF of approved suppliers", "average OTIF of approved suppliers", "PUR receipts (po_history)"),
            "Controlled-temperature deviations": kpi("Controlled-temperature deviations", None, "", 0, "down", "Temperature excursions in storage or transport", "count of logged excursions", "temperature loggers / LE events", available=False),
            "Spoilage rate": kpi("Spoilage rate", 100 * expired / value, "%", 0.5, "down", "Value of expired (spoiled) stock ÷ inventory value", "expired value ÷ stock value × 100", "MM batch expiry dates"),
            "Shelf-life remaining": kpi("Shelf-life remaining", sum(fg_expiry) / len(fg_expiry) if fg_expiry else None, " d", 180, "up", "Average days left before finished-good batches expire", "Σ days to expiry ÷ FG batches", "MM batch expiry dates", available=bool(fg_expiry)),
            "Cold-chain excursions": kpi("Cold-chain excursions", None, "", 0, "down", "Shipments or storage outside the cold-chain range", "count of excursions", "temperature loggers / LE events", available=False),
            "Ingredient freshness": kpi("Ingredient freshness", sum(rm_expiry) / len(rm_expiry) if rm_expiry else None, " d", 90, "up", "Average days left before ingredient batches expire", "Σ days to expiry ÷ ingredient batches", "MM batch expiry dates", available=bool(rm_expiry)),
            "Line-stop risk": kpi("Line-stop risk", len(not_ready), "", 0, "down", "Production orders that would stop for a missing component", "production orders not ready", "PP orders + BOM + stock + POs", status="critical" if not_ready else "good"),
            "Component shortages": kpi("Component shortages", sum(r["shortfall"] > 0 for r in comp_pos), "", 0, "down", "Component positions short of their 14-day target", "component positions with shortfall > 0", "MM stock + POs + PP requirements"),
            "Supplier delivery reliability": kpi("Supplier delivery reliability", sum(otd) / len(otd) if otd else None, "%", 95, "up", "On time in full deliveries by suppliers", "OTIF receipts ÷ receipts", "PUR receipts (po_history)"),
            "Production schedule adherence": kpi("Production schedule adherence", None, "%", 95, "up", "Orders finished on the planned date", "on-time confirmations ÷ orders", "PP order confirmations", available=False),
            "SKU availability": kpi("SKU availability", 100 * sum((r["days_of_cover"] or 0) >= 7 for r in fg_pos) / len(fg_pos) if fg_pos else None, "%", 98, "up", "Product × warehouse positions with at least 7 days of stock", "positions with ≥ 7 days of cover ÷ positions", "MM stock + demand"),
            "Fill rate": kpi("Fill rate", fill, "%", 98, "up", "Ordered quantity that can be confirmed", "confirmed quantity ÷ ordered quantity", "SD sales orders + stock + inbound"),
            "Returns rate": kpi("Returns rate", None, "%", 5, "down", "Returned quantity ÷ delivered quantity", "returns ÷ deliveries", "SD returns orders", available=False),
        }
        return {"industry": self.industry, "rules": INDUSTRY_RULES.get(self.industry, ""),
                "kpis": [catalogue[name] for name in INDUSTRY_KPIS.get(self.industry, INDUSTRY_KPIS["cosmetics"])]}

# ===== FUNCTION: RoleCenter.build() =====
    # ID: F0272 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/roles.py:345-368
    # ROLE: GET /api/v1/roles/{role}: dispatch to the role builder (_director, _demand, ...), then sort predictions (severity, soonest)
    #       and actions (severity, value at risk), sum value at risk and known fix costs, and add the agent card.
    # INPUTS:
    #   role: str, material: str | None.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> role view.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0054 create_app.role_view() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0261 RoleCenter._facts() (calls)
    #   -> F0410 SapRepository.material() (calls)
    def build(self, role: str, material: str | None = None) -> dict:
        if role not in ROLES:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown role {role}. Options: {', '.join(ROLES)}")
        spec = ROLES[role]
        f = self._facts(material)
        # Dynamic dispatch: getattr(self, "_director") etc.
        body = getattr(self, f"_{role}")(f, material)
        predictions = sorted(body["predictions"], key=lambda p: ({"critical": 0, "warning": 1, "info": 2}[p["severity"]], p.get("in_days") if p.get("in_days") is not None else 999))
        actions = sorted(body["actions"], key=lambda a: ({"critical": 0, "warning": 1, "info": 2}[a["severity"]], -(a.get("at_risk_eur") or 0)))
        at_risk = sum(p.get("at_risk_eur") or 0 for p in predictions if p["severity"] != "info")
        known = [a["fix_cost_eur"] for a in actions if a.get("fix_cost_eur") is not None]
        focus = None
        if material:
            focus = {"material": material, "description": self.engine.sap.material(material)["description"]}
        return {
            "role": role, "title": spec["title"], "focus": spec["focus"], "mvp": spec["mvp"], "priority": spec["priority"],
            "as_of": self.engine.sap.as_of.isoformat(), "product": focus,
            "agent": {"name": spec["agent"], "mission": spec["recommends"], "tools": spec["tools"] or "all read-only tools",
                      "starters": spec["starters"], "industry": self.industry},
            "kpis": body["kpis"], "predictions": predictions[:12],
            "cost": {"at_risk_eur": round(at_risk, 0), "fix_cost_eur": round(sum(known), 0), "fixes_with_cost": len(known), "fixes": len(actions),
                     "note": "Value at risk at standard cost; issues can overlap (for example a stock-out and the order it shorts)."},
            "actions": actions[:10], "charts": body.get("charts", []), "tables": body.get("tables", []),
            "forecast": body.get("forecast"),
        }

# ===== FUNCTION: RoleCenter._stock_predictions() =====
    # ID: F0274 · method · used (framework)
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/roles.py:377-389
    # ROLE: Dated stock predictions (stock-out / below safety) from the sales-outlook calendar, with value at risk for stock-outs.
    # INPUTS:
    #   f.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   list[dict].
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0281 RoleCenter._director() (calls)
    #   <- F0282 RoleCenter._demand() (calls)
    #   <- F0285 RoleCenter._warehouse() (calls)
    #   <- F0286 RoleCenter._logistics() (calls)
    #   <- F0288 RoleCenter._finance() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   (none found)
    def _stock_predictions(self, f) -> list[dict]:
        out = []
        for ev in f["calendar"]:
            if ev["kind"] not in ("stockout", "below_safety"):
                continue
            days = ev["days_from_today"]
            issue = next((i for i in f["issues"] if i["area"] == "Stock" and i["material"] == ev["material"] and i["action"]["params"].get("warehouse") == ev["warehouse"]), None)
            out.append({"severity": ("critical" if days <= 14 else "warning" if days <= 30 else "info") if ev["kind"] == "stockout" else ("warning" if days <= 14 else "info"),
                        "what": f"{ev['description']} {'runs out' if ev['kind'] == 'stockout' else 'drops below safety stock'} at {ev['warehouse']}",
                        "when": ev["date"], "in_days": days, "area": "Stock",
                        "basis": "stock + inbound shipments + planned production − XGBoost daily forecast",
                        "at_risk_eur": issue["at_risk_eur"] if issue and ev["kind"] == "stockout" else None})
        return out

            value = float(o["quantity"]) * f["cost"][o["material"]]
            out.append({"severity": "critical" if o["readiness"] == "not_ready" else "warning", "area": "Production",
                        "what": f"Production order {o['order']} ({o['material']} @ {o['plant']}) will miss its finish date unless {', '.join(o['short_components']) or 'components'} arrive",
                        "when": o["finish_date"], "in_days": days, "basis": f"BOM netting: {o['component_readiness_pct']}% of components covered by stock + confirmed POs",
                        "at_risk_eur": value})
        return out

# ===== FUNCTION: RoleCenter._supplier_predictions() =====
    # ID: F0276 · method · used (framework)
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/roles.py:404-417
    # ROLE: POs likely to arrive late, based on the supplier's average actual delay (>= 2 days).
    # INPUTS:
    #   f.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   list[dict].
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0281 RoleCenter._director() (calls)
    #   <- F0284 RoleCenter._procurement() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    #   -> F0404 SapRepository.as_of() (references)
    def _supplier_predictions(self, f) -> list[dict]:
        sap, out = self.engine.sap, []
        delay = {s["supplier"]: s["average_delay_days"] or 0 for s in f["suppliers"]}
        for po in sap.section("purchase_orders"):
            if f["scope"] and po["material"] not in f["scope"]:
                continue
            d = delay.get(po["supplier"], 0)
            if d >= 2:
                likely = date.fromisoformat(po["delivery_date"]) + timedelta(days=round(d))
                out.append({"severity": "warning" if d < 7 else "critical", "area": "Suppliers",
                            "what": f"PO {po['po']} ({po['material']}) from {po['supplier']} likely arrives {likely.isoformat()}, not {po['delivery_date']}",
                            "when": likely.isoformat(), "in_days": (likely - sap.as_of).days, "basis": f"supplier's average actual delay +{d:g} days on past receipts",
                            "at_risk_eur": float(po["quantity"]) * f["cost"][po["material"]]})
        return out

# ===== FUNCTION: RoleCenter._quality_predictions() =====
    # ID: F0278 · method · used (framework)
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/roles.py:430-446
    # ROLE: Quality lots that may hold production, plus batches expired or expiring within 90 days.
    # INPUTS:
    #   f.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   list[dict].
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0283 RoleCenter._production() (calls)
    #   <- F0285 RoleCenter._warehouse() (calls)
    #   <- F0287 RoleCenter._quality() (calls)
    #   <- F0288 RoleCenter._finance() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   (none found)
    def _quality_predictions(self, f) -> list[dict]:
        as_of, out = self.engine.sap.as_of, []
        for imp in f["quality"]["production_impacts"]:
            lot = next(lot for lot in f["quality"]["lots"] if lot["lot"] == imp["lot"])
            if f["scope"] and lot["material"] not in f["scope"]:
                continue
            out.append({"severity": "critical" if lot["status"] == "blocked" else "warning", "area": "Quality",
                        "what": f"Lot {lot['lot']} ({lot['material']}, {lot['status']}) may hold production order {imp['production_order']} due {imp['finish_date']}",
                        "when": lot.get("expected_release") or imp["finish_date"], "in_days": (date.fromisoformat(lot.get("expected_release") or imp["finish_date"]) - as_of).days,
                        "basis": f"QM status {lot['status']}" + (f", expected release {lot['expected_release']}" if lot.get("expected_release") else ""),
                        "at_risk_eur": float(lot["quantity"]) * f["cost"][lot["material"]]})
        for r in f["expiry"]:
            if r["days_left"] <= 90:
                out.append({"severity": "critical" if r["days_left"] < 0 else "warning" if r["days_left"] <= 30 else "info", "area": "Expiry",
                            "what": f"Batch {r['batch']} ({r['material']} @ {r['plant']}) {'has expired' if r['days_left'] < 0 else 'expires'} {r['expiry']}",
                            "when": r["expiry"], "in_days": r["days_left"], "basis": "batch expiry date in SAP", "at_risk_eur": r["value_eur"]})
        return out

    #   -> F0267 RoleCenter.platform_kpis() (calls)
    #   -> F0258 kpi() (calls)
    #   -> F0280 RoleCenter._charts() (calls)
    def _director(self, f, material) -> dict:
        learning = self.learning_summary(f)
        value = self._inventory_value(f)
        pending = len(self.store.list_recommendations("pending_review", self.engine.sap.snapshot["id"]))
        actions = self._issue_actions(f, limit=6)
        if pending:
            actions.insert(0, self._go("warning", f"Decide on {pending} recommendation{'s' if pending > 1 else ''} waiting for you", "Proposals from planners and agents need a manager decision",
                                       "approvals", "Review approvals"))
        predictions = (self._stock_predictions(f) + self._production_predictions(f) + self._supplier_predictions(f))
        kpis = self.platform_kpis(f)
        kpis.insert(2, kpi("Inventory value", value, "€", None, "down", "Stock value at standard cost across plants and warehouses", "Σ on hand × standard cost",
                           "MM stock + material master", status="info", hint=f"carrying cost ≈ €{value * CARRYING_COST_RATE:,.0f}/yr at 25%"))
        kpis.append(kpi("Verified outcomes", learning["verified_pct"], "%", 80, "up", "Executed decisions whose real result has been observed in SAP",
                        "observed outcomes ÷ executed recommendations × 100", "governance ledger + SAP documents",
                        hint=f"{learning['observed']} of {learning['executed']} executed"))
        return {"kpis": kpis, "predictions": predictions, "actions": actions, **self._charts("executive", material)}

    # ID: F0282 · method · used (framework)
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/roles.py:476-504
    # ROLE: Demand planner view: WAPE, bias, days of cover, projected stock-outs, demand variability; WAPE and bias charts.
    # INPUTS:
    #   f, material.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict.

    #   -> F0274 RoleCenter._stock_predictions() (calls)
    #   -> F0273 RoleCenter._issue_actions() (calls)
    def _demand(self, f, material) -> dict:
        models = f["models"]
        weight = sum(m["daily"] for m in models) or 1
        bias = sum(m["model"]["bias_pct"] * m["daily"] for m in models) / weight if models else None
        cv = sum(m["demand_cv_pct"] * m["daily"] for m in models) / weight if models else None
        fg = [r for r in f["positions"] if r["material_type"] == "FG"]
        cover = sum(r["on_hand"] for r in fg) / sum(r["requirement"] / 14 for r in fg) if fg and sum(r["requirement"] for r in fg) else None
        outs = [e for e in f["calendar"] if e["kind"] == "stockout"]
        kpis = [
            kpi("Forecast WAPE", self._wape(f), "%", 20, "down", "Sum of absolute forecast errors ÷ sum of actual demand", "Σ|forecast − actual| ÷ Σ actual × 100 (14-day holdout)", "SD billing history (synthetic)"),
            kpi("Forecast bias", bias, "%", 5, "down", "Systematic over- (+) or under-forecasting (−)", "Σ(forecast − actual) ÷ Σ actual × 100", "SD billing history (synthetic)",
                status=_status(abs(bias) if bias is not None else None, 5, "down"), hint="close to 0 is best"),
            kpi("Days of stock cover", cover, " d", 21, "up", "Finished-goods stock ÷ average daily demand", "Σ on hand ÷ Σ daily demand", "MM stock + demand"),
            kpi("Projected stock-outs (60 d)", len(outs), "", 0, "down", "Product × warehouse positions predicted to run out within 60 days",
                "count of projected stock-out dates", "stock + inbound + production − forecast", hint=f"first {outs[0]['date']} at {outs[0]['warehouse']}" if outs else "none predicted"),
            kpi("Demand variability", cv, "%", 15, "down", "Coefficient of variation of daily demand (last 28 days)", "std ÷ mean × 100", "SD billing history (synthetic)"),
        ]
        rows = sorted(models, key=lambda m: -m["model"]["wape_pct"])
        charts = [
            {"id": "wape", "type": "bar", "title": "Forecast error (WAPE) by product and warehouse", "subtitle": "14-day holdout; lower is better; 20% demo target",
             "unit": "%", "reference": 20, "reference_label": "target",
             "rows": [{"label": f"{m['material']} @ {m['warehouse']}", "value": m["model"]["wape_pct"], "status": _status(m["model"]["wape_pct"], 20, "down"),
                       "hint": f"bias {m['model']['bias_pct']:+}% · baseline WAPE {m['baseline']['wape_pct']}%"} for m in rows]},
            {"id": "bias", "type": "diverging", "title": "Forecast bias by product and warehouse", "subtitle": "+ over-forecast · − under-forecast (%)", "unit": "%",
             "rows": [{"label": f"{m['material']} @ {m['warehouse']}", "value": m["model"]["bias_pct"]} for m in rows]},
        ]
        extra = self._charts("inventory", material, {"cover"})
        return {"kpis": kpis, "predictions": self._stock_predictions(f), "actions": self._issue_actions(f, ROLES["demand"]["areas"]),
                "charts": charts + extra["charts"], "forecast": extra["forecast"]}
